title.zh: 卷三十二 志第十二: 曆一
title.raw: 卷三十二 志第十二: 曆一 Volume 32 Treatises 12: Calendar 1

sentences.zh: 志第十二曆一

translations.literal: Treatise 12, Calendars 1
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 12: Calendars, Part One

sentences.zh: 太古聖人，體二氣之權輿，賾三才之物象，乃創紀以窮其數，畫卦以通其變。

translations.literal: In utmost antiquity the sage embodied the origin of the two qì, probed the manifestations of the three powers, and thereby created chronology to exhaust number and drew the hexagrams to penetrate change.
translations.idiomatic: In remote antiquity, the sage took the genesis of yin and yang as his foundation, fathomed the forms of Heaven, Earth, and Man, established chronology to encompass all number, and drew the hexagrams to express transformation.

sentences.zh: 而紀有大衍之法，卦有推策之文，由是曆法生焉。

translations.literal: In chronology there was the method of Great Expansion; in the hexagrams there was the text of pushing the stalks—therefrom calendrical methods arose.
translations.idiomatic: Chronology acquired the Great Expansion method, and the hexagrams the art of stalk divination; from these, calendrical science was born.

sentences.zh: 殷人用九疇、五紀之書，《周禮》載馮相、保章之職，所以辨三辰之躔次，察九野之吉凶。

translations.literal: The Yin used the books of the Nine Categories and Five Chronologies; the Rites of Zhou records the offices of the Master of the Sphere and the Guardian of the Tablets, by which to distinguish the progression of the three luminaries and examine good and ill fortune in the nine regions.
translations.idiomatic: The Yin employed works on the Nine Categories and Five Chronologies, and the Rites of Zhou records the posts of the royal astronomer and calendar keeper, by which to chart the courses of sun, moon, and stars and discern fortune across the nine domains.

sentences.zh: 歷代疇人，迭相傳授，蓋推步之成法，協用之舊章。

translations.literal: Through successive ages specialists in the calendar transmitted one to another—this was the established method of astronomical computation and the old statutes applied in concert.
translations.idiomatic: Generation after generation, calendar specialists handed down their art, preserving the fixed methods of calculation and the long-established rules of cooperative use.

sentences.zh: 暨秦氏焚書，遺文殘缺，漢興作者，師法多門。

translations.literal: When the Qin burned the books, surviving texts were fragmentary; when the Han arose, those who composed calendars drew on many schools.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qin burning of the books left the tradition in tatters, the Han restoration saw calendar makers following many different lineages.

sentences.zh: 雖同征鐘律之文，共演蓍龜之說，而建元或異，積蔀相懸，旁取證於《春秋》，強乩疑於《系》、《象》，靡不揚眉抵掌，謂甘、石未稱日官；

translations.literal: Though all alike consulted texts on pitch-pipes and calendar cycles and jointly worked out the theory of yarrow and tortoise, their eras of origin differed and accumulated obscurations diverged; seeking collateral proof from the Spring and Autumn Annals and forcibly reading doubts into the Attached Expressions and Images, none failed to arch their brows and slap their palms, saying that Gān and Shí fell short of the title Directors of the Sun;
translations.idiomatic: Though they all cited the same writings on pitch-pipes and cycles and rehearsed the same lore of yarrow and tortoise divination, their epoch origins differed and their obscuration counts conflicted; they hunted corroboration in the Spring and Autumn Annals and forced strained readings on the Attached Commentaries and Images, every one of them smugly insisting that even Gān and Shí had not deserved to be called Directors of the Sun;

sentences.zh: 運策播精，言裨、梓不知天道。

translations.literal: manipulating stalks and spreading refinements, they said that Bi and Zǐ did not know the Way of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: wielding counting-rods and peddling subtle calculations, they declared that Bi and Zǐ had never understood Heaven's way.

sentences.zh: 及至清台眎祲，黃道考祥，言縮則盈，少中多否，否則矯雲差算，中則自負知時。

translations.literal: When it came to the Clear Platform observing omens and the Yellow Path examining auspices—when they spoke of contraction they meant expansion; few hits and many misses; on a miss they twisted clouds and revised calculations, on a hit they prided themselves on knowing the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the Clear Platform to watch for portents and tested fortune along the Yellow Path, what they called shrinkage turned out to be excess; they were wrong far more often than right—when wrong, they twisted omens and adjusted the math, and when right, they boasted that they alone knew the times.

sentences.zh: 章、亥不生，憑何質證？

translations.literal: Zhang and Hai did not attend birth—on what could one rely for verification?
translations.idiomatic: If Zhang and Hai were not present at the birth, what proof could there be?

sentences.zh: 高齊天保中，六月日當蝕朔，文宣先期問候官蝕何時，張孟賓言蝕申，鄭元偉、董峻言蝕辰，宋景業言蝕巳。

translations.literal: In the Tianbao era of Northern Qi, in the sixth month a solar eclipse was due at new moon. Wenxuan in advance asked the observer when the eclipse would occur: Zhang Mengbin said the hour shen, Zheng Yuanwei and Dong Jun said the hour chen, and Song Jingye said the hour si.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianbao reign of Northern Qi, a solar eclipse at new moon was expected in the sixth month. Emperor Wenxuan asked the court astronomer beforehand when it would occur: Zhang Mengbin predicted the hour shen, Zheng Yuanwei and Dong Jun the hour chen, and Song Jingye the hour si.

sentences.zh: 是日蝕于申酉之間，言皆不中時。

translations.literal: That day the eclipse fell between the hours shen and you; all their predictions missed the time.
translations.idiomatic: On that day the eclipse occurred between shen and you, and every prediction was wrong as to the hour.

sentences.zh: 景業造《天保曆》則疏密可知矣。

translations.literal: When Jingye composed the Tianbao Calendar, its coarse accuracy and fine precision could be known.
translations.idiomatic: From the Tianbao Calendar that Jingye devised, one could see plainly how close or how far off it was.

sentences.zh: 昔鄧平、洛下閎造漢《太初曆》，非之者十七家。

translations.literal: Formerly Dèng Píng and Luòxià Hóng composed the Han Taichu Calendar, and seventeen schools opposed it.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Dèng Píng and Luòxià Hóng devised the Han Taichu Calendar, which seventeen rival schools rejected.

sentences.zh: 後劉洪、蔡伯喈、何承天、祖沖之，皆數術之精粹者，至於宣考曆書之際，猶為橫議所排。

translations.literal: Later Liú Hóng, Cài Bójiē, Hé Chéngtiān, and Zǔ Chōngzhī were all masters refined in numerology and the arts; yet when it came to promulgating and examining calendar books, they were still set aside by reckless dispute.
translations.idiomatic: Later Liú Hóng, Cài Bójiē, Hé Chéngtiān, and Zǔ Chōngzhī were all paragons of mathematical astronomy, yet even when their calendars were submitted for imperial review, reckless controversy still blocked them.

sentences.zh: 斯道寂寥，知音蓋寡。

translations.literal: This Way was desolate and still; those who truly understood were few indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The discipline languished in solitude, and those who truly grasped it were exceedingly few.

sentences.zh: 所以張胄玄佩印而沸騰，劉孝孫輿棺而慟哭，俾諸後學，益用為疑。

translations.literal: Hence Zhāng Zhòuxuán wore his seal amid uproar, and Liú Xiàosūn bore a coffin in bitter lament—so that later students only grew the more doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: Hence Zhāng Zhòuxuán took office amid a storm of controversy, and Liú Xiàosūn marched with a coffin in mourning protest, leaving later students all the more uncertain.

sentences.zh: 以臣折衷，無如舊法。

translations.literal: In this subject's judgment after weighing all sides, nothing surpasses the old methods.
translations.idiomatic: In my judgment, after weighing every side, nothing equals the established methods.

sentences.zh: 高祖受隋禪，傅仁均首陳七事，言戊寅歲時正得上元之首，宜定新曆，以符禪代，由是造《戊寅曆》。

translations.literal: When Gaozu received the abdication of Sui, Fù Rénjūn was first to present seven proposals, saying that in the wùyín year the seasons correctly aligned with the head of the Superior Epoch, and that a new calendar should be fixed to match the transfer of the mandate—thereby the Wùyín Calendar was composed.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne from the Sui, Fù Rénjūn was the first to submit seven proposals, arguing that the year wùyín fell precisely at the opening of the Superior Epoch and that a new calendar should be established to mark the dynastic transition; thus the Wùyín Calendar was created.

sentences.zh: 祖孝孫、李淳風立理駁之，仁均條答甚詳，故法行於貞觀之世。

translations.literal: Zǔ Xiàosūn and Lǐ Chúnfēng set forth reasoned refutations; Rénjūn answered point by point in great detail, and therefore the method was used throughout the Zhenguan era.
translations.idiomatic: Zǔ Xiàosūn and Lǐ Chúnfēng advanced reasoned objections, to which Rénjūn replied in meticulous detail, and the system therefore remained in force throughout the Zhenguan reign.

sentences.zh: 高宗時，太史奏舊曆加時浸差，宜有改定，乃詔李淳風造《麟德曆》。

translations.literal: In the Gaozong era the Grand Astrologer reported that the old calendar's time additions were gradually drifting and ought to be revised; an edict then ordered Lǐ Chúnfēng to compose the Líndé Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Under Gaozong, the court astronomer reported that the old calendar's time corrections were gradually slipping and should be revised; the emperor then ordered Lǐ Chúnfēng to devise the Líndé Calendar.

sentences.zh: 初，隋末劉焯造《皇極曆》，其道不行，淳風約之為法，時稱精密。

translations.literal: Earlier, at the end of Sui, Liú Zhuó composed the Huangji Calendar, but its method was not adopted; Chúnfēng distilled it into a system, which at the time was called precise.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the end of the Sui, Liú Zhuó had devised the Huangji Calendar, but his method had never been adopted; Chúnfēng distilled it into a workable system that contemporaries hailed as precise.

sentences.zh: 天后時，瞿曇羅造《光宅曆》。

translations.literal: In the era of the Heavenly Empress, Qútánluó composed the Guangzhai Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of Empress Wu, Qútánluó devised the Guangzhai Calendar.

sentences.zh: 中宗時，南宮說造《景龍曆》，皆舊法之所棄者，復取用之。

translations.literal: In the Zhongzong era, Nángōng Yuè composed the Jinglong Calendar—all methods that the old system had discarded, yet they were taken up again for use.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhongzong, Nángōng Yuè devised the Jinglong Calendar, reviving methods that the established system had long since discarded.

sentences.zh: 徒雲革易，寧造深微，尋亦不行。

translations.literal: They only spoke of reform and change, yet could not produce anything profound or subtle; before long these too were not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: They talked of reform but could produce nothing truly profound, and before long their calendars too fell out of use.

sentences.zh: 開元中，僧一行精諸家曆法，言《麟德曆》行用既久，晷緯漸差。

translations.literal: In the Kaiyuan era the monk Yīxíng was master of all schools of calendrical method and said that the Líndé Calendar had been in use so long that gnomon shadows and celestial coordinates were gradually drifting.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan reign, the monk Yīxíng mastered every school of calendrical science and reported that the Líndé Calendar, long in use, was gradually slipping in its gnomon readings and celestial coordinates.

sentences.zh: 宰相張說言之，玄宗召見，令造新曆。

translations.literal: The chief minister Zhāng Yuè reported this; Xuánzong summoned Yīxíng and ordered him to compose a new calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Zhāng Yuè relayed the report, and Xuánzong summoned Yīxíng and ordered him to devise a new calendar.

sentences.zh: 遂與星官梁令瓚先造《黃道遊儀圖》，考校七曜行度，准《周易》大衍之數，別成一法，行用垂五十年。

translations.literal: He then joined the star-official Liáng Lìngqiàn in first composing the Diagram of the Yellow Path Armillary Sphere, verifying the motions of the seven luminaries, taking the Great Expansion numbers of the Book of Changes as standard, and establishing a separate method that remained in use for nearly fifty years.
translations.idiomatic: He then worked with the court astronomer Liáng Lìngqiàn to produce the Diagram of the Yellow-Path Armillary Sphere, verified the motions of the seven luminaries, took the Great Expansion numbers of the Book of Changes as his standard, and established a new method that remained in use for nearly fifty years.

sentences.zh: 肅宗時，韓潁造《至德曆》。

translations.literal: In the Suzong era, Hán Yǐng composed the Zhide Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Under Suzong, Hán Yǐng devised the Zhide Calendar.

sentences.zh: 代宗時，郭獻之造《五紀曆》。

translations.literal: In the Daizong era, Guō Xiànzhī composed the Five Chronologies Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Under Daizong, Guō Xiànzhī devised the Five Chronologies Calendar.

sentences.zh: 德宗時，徐承嗣造《正元曆》。

translations.literal: In the Dezong era, Xú Chéngsì composed the Zhengyuan Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Under Dezong, Xú Chéngsì devised the Zhengyuan Calendar.

sentences.zh: 憲宗時，徐昂造《觀象曆》。

translations.literal: In the Xianzong era, Xú Áng composed the Guanxiang Calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Under Xianzong, Xú Áng devised the Guanxiang Calendar.

sentences.zh: 其法今存，而元紀蔀章之數，或異前經；

translations.literal: Its method survives today, yet the numbers of origin, chronology, obscuration, and rule sometimes differ from earlier classics;
translations.idiomatic: Its method survives to this day, though the figures for origin, era, obscuration, and rule sometimes diverge from earlier canonical systems;

sentences.zh: 而察斂啟閉之期，何殊舊法。

translations.literal: yet in discerning the periods of contraction, opening, and closing, how do they differ from the old methods?
translations.idiomatic: yet in determining the seasons of contraction, opening, and closing, how do they differ from the established methods?

sentences.zh: 至論征驗，罕及研精。

translations.literal: When it came to testing and verification, few reached true refinement.
translations.idiomatic: As for empirical testing, few ever pursued it with real rigor.

sentences.zh: 綿代流行，示存經法耳。

translations.literal: Passed down through successive ages, they merely show that the canonical methods survive.
translations.idiomatic: Handed down through the ages, they merely attest that the canonical methods endure.

sentences.zh: 前史取傅仁均、李淳風、南宮說、一行四家歷經，為《曆志》四卷。

translations.literal: The previous history took the calendar classics of four houses—Fù Rénjūn, Lǐ Chúnfēng, Nángōng Yuè, and Yīxíng—and made them into four fascicles of the Calendar Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier history drew on the calendar classics of Fù Rénjūn, Lǐ Chúnfēng, Nángōng Yuè, and Yīxíng to form four fascicles of the Calendar Treatise.

sentences.zh: 近代精數者，皆以淳風、一行之法，曆千古而無差，後人更之，要立異耳，無逾其精密也。

translations.literal: Recent masters of refined calculation all hold that the methods of Chúnfēng and Yīxíng are without error through a thousand ages; later men who revised them only sought to establish novelty and could not surpass their precision.
translations.idiomatic: Recent masters of calculation agree that the methods of Chúnfēng and Yīxíng have stood without error for ages; later revisions aimed chiefly at novelty and never surpassed their precision.

sentences.zh: 《景龍曆》不經行用，世以為非，今略而不載。

translations.literal: The Jinglong Calendar was never put into practice; the age regarded it as unsound, and it is here omitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinglong Calendar was never adopted in practice and was widely judged unsound; it is therefore omitted here.

sentences.zh: 但取《戊寅》、《麟德》、《大衍》三曆法，以備此志，示於疇官爾。

translations.literal: Only the methods of the three calendars Wùyín, Líndé, and Dayan are taken to complete this treatise, for display to calendar specialists.
translations.idiomatic: Only the methods of the Wùyín, Líndé, and Dayan calendars are included in this treatise, for the use of calendar specialists.

sentences.zh: 戊寅歷經

translations.literal: Classic of the Wùyín Calendar
translations.idiomatic: The Wùyín Calendar Classic

sentences.zh: 已上闕文日。

translations.literal: Above this point the text is missing for [a certain number of] days.
translations.idiomatic: The text above is missing for the indicated number of days.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋，初日加四千八十分，後日減七十六分，置初日所加之分，計後日減之數以減之。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Autumn, on the first day add 4,080 parts; on each later day subtract 76 parts. Set the parts added on the first day, compute the cumulative subtraction for later days, and subtract accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Autumn, add 4,080 parts on the first day and subtract 76 parts on each succeeding day: record the first day's addition, total the daily subtractions, and deduct them.

sentences.zh: 訖，餘以行分法約之，為日數。

translations.literal: When finished, reduce the remainder by the motion-part divisor to obtain the number of days.
translations.idiomatic: When done, divide the remainder by the motion-part divisor to obtain the day count.

sentences.zh: 及加平見日及分，滿行分法，又去之，從日一，為定見日及分。

translations.literal: Then add the mean-appearance days and parts; when they fill the motion-part divisor, remove it and carry one to the days—this yields the true-appearance days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add these to the mean-appearance days and parts; whenever the total fills the motion-part divisor, discard one divisor and carry one day—this gives the true-appearance days and parts.

sentences.zh: 後皆放此。

translations.literal: All that follows is done by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: The same procedure applies to all cases below.

sentences.zh: 畢于秋分。

translations.literal: Continue until Autumn Equinox.
translations.idiomatic: Continue through Autumn Equinox.

sentences.zh: 自入寒露，日減一百二十七分，減若不足，即一日加行分法，反減之，為定見日及分。

translations.literal: From entering Cold Dew, subtract 127 parts each day; if the subtraction is insufficient, add one day and the motion-part divisor, then subtract in reverse, to obtain the true-appearance days and parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Cold Dew, subtract 127 parts daily; if subtraction is insufficient, add one day plus the motion-part divisor and subtract in reverse to obtain the true-appearance days and parts.

sentences.zh: 後皆放此。

translations.literal: All that follows is done by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: The same procedure applies to all cases below.

sentences.zh: 畢于立冬。

translations.literal: Continue until Beginning of Winter.
translations.idiomatic: Continue through Beginning of Winter.

sentences.zh: 自入小雪，畢于大雪，均減八日。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Snow through Major Snow, uniformly subtract eight days.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through Major Snow, uniformly subtract 8 days.

sentences.zh: 初見去日十四度。

translations.literal: At first appearance, the distance from the sun is fourteen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, the planet stands fourteen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 平見：入冬至，初日減一萬六千三百五十四分，後日減五百四十五分，畢於小寒。

translations.literal: Mean appearance: entering winter solstice, on the first day subtract 16,354 parts; on each later day subtract 545 parts; continue until Minor Cold.
translations.idiomatic: Mean appearance: entering winter solstice, subtract 16,354 parts on the first day and 545 parts on each succeeding day, through Minor Cold.

sentences.zh: 自入大寒，日加四百二十六分，畢於啟蟄。

translations.literal: From entering Major Cold, add 426 parts each day; continue until Awakening of Insects.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold, add 426 parts daily through Awakening of Insects.

sentences.zh: 自入雨水，畢于穀雨，均加二十九日。

translations.literal: From entering Rain Water through Grain Rain, uniformly add twenty-nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water through Grain Rain, uniformly add 29 days.

sentences.zh: 入立夏，初日加一萬九千三百九十二分，後日減二百一十三分，畢於大暑。

translations.literal: Entering Beginning of Summer, on the first day add 19,392 parts; on each later day subtract 213 parts; continue until Major Heat.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Beginning of Summer, add 19,392 parts on the first day and subtract 213 parts on each succeeding day, through Major Heat.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Autumn, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Autumn, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑，日減一百八十四分，畢于立冬。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat, subtract 184 parts each day; continue until Beginning of Winter.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat, subtract 184 parts daily through Beginning of Winter.

sentences.zh: 自入小雪，畢于大雪。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Snow through Major Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through Major Snow.

sentences.zh: 均減二十五日。

translations.literal: Uniformly subtract twenty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: Uniformly subtract 25 days.

sentences.zh: 初見去日十七度。

translations.literal: At first appearance, the distance from the sun is seventeen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, the planet stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 平見：入冬至，初日減四千八百一十四分，後日加七十九分，畢於氣盡。

translations.literal: Mean appearance: entering winter solstice, on the first day subtract 4,814 parts; on each later day add 79 parts; continue until the qi is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Mean appearance: entering winter solstice, subtract 4,814 parts on the first day and add 79 parts on each succeeding day, until the qi period ends.

sentences.zh: 自入小寒，畢于大寒。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Cold through Major Cold.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold through Major Cold.

sentences.zh: 均減九日。

translations.literal: Uniformly subtract nine days.
translations.idiomatic: Uniformly subtract 9 days.

sentences.zh: 入立春，均減八日。

translations.literal: Entering Beginning of Spring, uniformly subtract eight days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Beginning of Spring, uniformly subtract 8 days.

sentences.zh: 入啟蟄，均減七日。

translations.literal: Entering Awakening of Insects, uniformly subtract seven days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Awakening of Insects, uniformly subtract 7 days.

sentences.zh: 入雨水，均減六日。

translations.literal: Entering Rain Water, uniformly subtract six days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Rain Water, uniformly subtract 6 days.

sentences.zh: 入春分，均減五日。

translations.literal: Entering Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract five days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract 5 days.

sentences.zh: 入清明，均減四日。

translations.literal: Entering Clear Brightness, uniformly subtract four days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Clear Brightness, uniformly subtract 4 days.

sentences.zh: 入穀雨，畢芒種，均減三日。

translations.literal: Entering Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, uniformly subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, uniformly subtract 3 days.

sentences.zh: 入夏至，畢十日內，均減二日。

translations.literal: Entering summer solstice, within the first ten days, uniformly subtract two days.
translations.idiomatic: Entering summer solstice, within the first ten days uniformly subtract 2 days.

sentences.zh: 十日外，入小暑，畢五日內，均減一日。

translations.literal: Beyond the tenth day, entering Minor Heat, within the first five days, uniformly subtract one day.
translations.idiomatic: After the tenth day, entering Minor Heat, within the first five days uniformly subtract 1 day.

sentences.zh: 五日外，畢於氣盡，依平。

translations.literal: Beyond the fifth day, until the qi is exhausted, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: After the fifth day, until the qi period ends, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入大暑，日加一百八十一分，畢于立秋。

translations.literal: From entering Major Heat, add 181 parts each day; continue until Beginning of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Heat, add 181 parts daily through Beginning of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑，均加九日。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat, uniformly add nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat, uniformly add 9 days.

sentences.zh: 自入白露，初日加六千二分，後日減一百三十三分，畢於寒露。

translations.literal: From entering White Dew, on the first day add 6,002 parts; on each later day subtract 133 parts; continue until Cold Dew.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew, add 6,002 parts on the first day and subtract 133 parts on each succeeding day, through Cold Dew.

sentences.zh: 自入霜降，日減七十九分，畢于大雪。

translations.literal: From entering Frost's Descent, subtract 79 parts each day; continue until Major Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost's Descent, subtract 79 parts daily through Major Snow.

sentences.zh: 初見去日十七度。

translations.literal: At first appearance, the distance from the sun is seventeen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, the planet stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 晨平見：入冬至，依平。

translations.literal: Morning mean appearance: entering winter solstice, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: Morning mean appearance: entering winter solstice, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入小寒，日加六十六分，畢于大寒。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Cold, add 66 parts each day; continue until Major Cold.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold, add 66 parts daily through Major Cold.

sentences.zh: 自入立春，畢于立夏，均加三日。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Spring through Beginning of Summer, uniformly add three days.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Spring through Beginning of Summer, uniformly add 3 days.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿，初日加一千九百六十四分，後日減六十六分，畢於芒種。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness, on the first day add 1,964 parts; on each later day subtract 66 parts; continue until Grain in Ear.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness, add 1,964 parts on the first day and subtract 66 parts on each succeeding day, through Grain in Ear.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至，依平。

translations.literal: From entering summer solstice, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From summer solstice, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入小暑，減六十分，畢於大暑。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Heat, subtract 60 parts [each day]; continue until Major Heat.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Heat, subtract 60 parts daily through Major Heat.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋，畢于立冬，均減三日。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Autumn through Beginning of Winter, uniformly subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Autumn through Beginning of Winter, uniformly subtract 3 days.

sentences.zh: 自入小雪，初日減一千九百六十四分，後日減六十六分，畢大寒。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Snow, on the first day subtract 1,964 parts; on each later day subtract 66 parts; continue until Major Cold.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow, subtract 1,964 parts on the first day and 66 parts on each succeeding day, through Major Cold.

sentences.zh: 夕平見：入冬至，日減一百分，畢于立春。

translations.literal: Evening mean appearance: entering winter solstice, subtract 100 parts each day; continue until Beginning of Spring.
translations.idiomatic: Evening mean appearance: entering winter solstice, subtract 100 parts daily through Beginning of Spring.

sentences.zh: 自入啟蟄，畢于春分，均減九日。

translations.literal: From entering Awakening of Insects through Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects through Spring Equinox, uniformly subtract 9 days.

sentences.zh: 自入清明，初日減五千九百八十六分，後日減一百分，畢于小滿。

translations.literal: From entering Clear Brightness, on the first day subtract 5,986 parts; on each later day subtract 100 parts; continue until Minor Fullness.
translations.idiomatic: From Clear Brightness, subtract 5,986 parts on the first day and 100 parts on each succeeding day, through Minor Fullness.

sentences.zh: 自入芒種，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Grain in Ear, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Grain in Ear, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至，日加一百分，畢于立秋。

translations.literal: From entering summer solstice, add 100 parts each day; continue until Beginning of Autumn.
translations.idiomatic: From summer solstice, add 100 parts daily through Beginning of Autumn.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑，畢于秋分，均加九日。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat through Autumn Equinox, uniformly add nine days.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Autumn Equinox, uniformly add 9 days.

sentences.zh: 自入寒露，初日加五千九百八十六分，後日減一百分，畢于小雪。

translations.literal: From entering Cold Dew, on the first day add 5,986 parts; on each later day subtract 100 parts; continue until Minor Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Cold Dew, add 5,986 parts on the first day and subtract 100 parts on each succeeding day, through Minor Snow.

sentences.zh: 自入大雪，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Major Snow, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Major Snow, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 初見去日十一度。

translations.literal: At first appearance, the distance from the sun is eleven degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, the planet stands eleven degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 晨平見：入冬至，均減四日。

translations.literal: Morning mean appearance: entering winter solstice, uniformly subtract four days.
translations.idiomatic: Morning mean appearance: entering winter solstice, uniformly subtract 4 days.

sentences.zh: 自入小寒，畢于大寒，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Cold through Major Cold, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Cold through Major Cold, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入立春，畢啟蟄，減三日。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Spring through Awakening of Insects, subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Spring through Awakening of Insects, subtract 3 days.

sentences.zh: 其在啟蟄氣內，去日一十八度外、四十度內，晨無木、土、金一星已上者，不見也。

translations.literal: If within the qi of Awakening of Insects the distance from the sun is beyond eighteen degrees but within forty degrees, and at morning there is no Jupiter, Saturn, or Venus above, it will not be visible.
translations.idiomatic: If during the Awakening of Insects period the planet lies more than eighteen but less than forty degrees from the sun, and Jupiter, Saturn, or Venus are not above the horizon at dawn, it will not be seen.

sentences.zh: 自入雨水，畢于立夏，應見不見。

translations.literal: From entering Rain Water through Beginning of Summer, when it ought to appear it does not.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water through Beginning of Summer, it should be visible but is not.

sentences.zh: 其在立夏氣內，去日度如前，晨有木、火、土、金一星已上者，亦見之。

translations.literal: If within the qi of Beginning of Summer the distance from the sun is as before, and at morning Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, or Venus are above, it will also be visible.
translations.idiomatic: If during the Beginning of Summer period the planet lies at the same distance from the sun as above, and Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, or Venus are above the horizon at dawn, it will be visible.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿，畢於寒露，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness through Cold Dew, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness through Cold Dew, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入霜降，畢于立冬，加一日。

translations.literal: From entering Frost's Descent through Beginning of Winter, add one day.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost's Descent through Beginning of Winter, add 1 day.

sentences.zh: 自入小雪，畢于大雪十二日，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Snow through the twelfth day of Major Snow, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Snow through the twelfth day of Major Snow, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 若在大雪十三日，即減一日。

translations.literal: If on the thirteenth day of Major Snow, subtract one day.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of Major Snow, subtract 1 day.

sentences.zh: 在十四日，減二日。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day, subtract two days.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day, subtract 2 days.

sentences.zh: 在十五日，減三日。

translations.literal: On the fifteenth day, subtract three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day, subtract 3 days.

sentences.zh: 在十六日，減四日。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day, subtract four days.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day, subtract 4 days.

sentences.zh: 夕平見：入冬至，畢于清明，依平。

translations.literal: Evening mean appearance: entering winter solstice through Clear Brightness, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: Evening mean appearance: from winter solstice through Clear Brightness, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入穀雨，畢於芒種，減二日。

translations.literal: From entering Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, subtract two days.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain Rain through Grain in Ear, subtract 2 days.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至，畢於大暑，依平。

translations.literal: From entering summer solstice through Major Heat, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From summer solstice through Major Heat, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋，畢于霜降，應見不見。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Autumn through Frost's Descent, when it ought to appear it does not.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Autumn through Frost's Descent, it should be visible but is not.

sentences.zh: 其在立秋及霜降二氣之內，夕有星去日如前晨者，亦見。

translations.literal: If within the two qi of Beginning of Autumn and Frost's Descent, at evening a star's distance from the sun is as in the morning case above, it will also be visible.
translations.idiomatic: If during Beginning of Autumn and Frost's Descent, at evening the planet stands at the same distance from the sun as in the morning rule above, it will be seen.

sentences.zh: 自入立冬，畢于大雪，依平。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Winter through Major Snow, follow the mean [method].
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Winter through Major Snow, follow the mean-rate procedure.

sentences.zh: 初見去日十七度。

translations.literal: At first appearance, the distance from the sun is seventeen degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At first appearance, the planet stands seventeen degrees from the sun.

sentences.zh: 行五星法

translations.literal: Method for the motion of the five planets
translations.idiomatic: Rules for the Motion of the Five Planets

sentences.zh: 各置星定見之前夜半日所在宿度算及分，各以定見去朔日算及一分加之。

translations.literal: For each planet set the lodge-degree count and parts of the sun's position at midnight before the true appearance; to each add the count and one part of the days from true appearance back to new moon.
translations.idiomatic: For each planet, record the sun's lodge, degree, count, and parts at midnight before true appearance, then add the count and one part of the interval from true appearance back to new moon.

sentences.zh: 小分滿法十四分，從行分一。

translations.literal: When minor parts fill fourteen parts of the divisor, carry one to the motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: When minor parts fill fourteen divisor-parts, carry 1 to the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 行分滿法六百七十六分，從度一。

translations.literal: When motion parts fill 676 parts of the divisor, carry one to the degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When motion parts fill 676 divisor-parts, carry 1 degree.

sentences.zh: 又以星初見去日度數，晨減夕加之。

translations.literal: Then with the degrees of the planet's first-appearance distance from the sun, subtract for morning and add for evening.
translations.idiomatic: Then apply the first-appearance distance from the sun in degrees: subtract for morning visibility, add for evening.

sentences.zh: 命度以次，即星初見所在度及分。

translations.literal: Count off the degrees in order—this gives the degree and parts where the planet first appears.
translations.idiomatic: Count through the degrees in sequence to obtain the degree and parts of the planet's first appearance.

sentences.zh: 自此已後，皆棄此小分也。

translations.literal: From this point onward, all such minor parts are discarded.
translations.idiomatic: From this point on, discard these minor parts.

sentences.zh: 求次日術

translations.literal: Procedure for finding the next day
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for the Following Day

sentences.zh: 各加一日所行度及分。

translations.literal: To each add the degrees and parts traveled in one day.
translations.idiomatic: Add the degrees and parts the planet travels in one day.

sentences.zh: 其火、金之行而有小分者，各以日率為母。

translations.literal: For the motion of Mars and Venus where there are minor parts, take the daily rate as denominator for each.
translations.idiomatic: For Mars and Venus when minor parts are involved, use the daily rate as the denominator.

sentences.zh: 小分滿其母，去從行分一。

translations.literal: When minor parts fill their denominator, remove it and carry one to the motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: When minor parts fill their denominator, discard it and carry 1 to the motion parts.

sentences.zh: 行分滿法，去從度一。

translations.literal: When motion parts fill the divisor, remove it and carry one to the degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When motion parts fill the divisor, discard it and carry 1 degree.

sentences.zh: 其行有益疾遲者，副置一日行分。

translations.literal: Where motion has accelerating or decelerating phases, set aside the one-day motion parts as auxiliary.
translations.idiomatic: When motion accelerates or decelerates, set aside the one-day motion parts as auxiliary values.

sentences.zh: 各以其分疾益遲損，乃加之。

translations.literal: For each, add or subtract according to whether the parts accelerate or decelerate.
translations.idiomatic: Apply acceleration or deceleration to the parts accordingly, then add.

sentences.zh: 留者因前，退則減之，伏不注度。

translations.literal: During station, continue from the previous value; during retrograde, subtract; during occultation, do not record degrees.
translations.idiomatic: During station, hold the previous value; during retrograde, subtract; during occultation, do not record motion in degrees.

sentences.zh: 順行出鬥去其分，行入鬥先加分。

translations.literal: In direct motion leaving Dipper, remove its parts; entering Dipper, add parts first.
translations.idiomatic: When moving direct out of Dipper, subtract its parts; when entering Dipper, add parts first.

sentences.zh: 訖，皆以二十六副行分為度分。

translations.literal: When finished, in all cases take twenty-six auxiliary motion parts as degree parts.
translations.idiomatic: In all cases, treat 26 auxiliary motion parts as degree parts.

sentences.zh: 初見：順，日行一百七十六分五十秒，日益遲一分。

translations.literal: First appearance: direct motion, 176 parts 50 seconds per day, daily deceleration of one part.
translations.idiomatic: First appearance: direct motion at 176 parts 50 seconds per day, slowing by 1 part each day.

sentences.zh: 一百一十四日行十九度二百九分。

translations.literal: In 114 days it travels 19 degrees 209 parts.
translations.idiomatic: In 114 days it travels 19°209′.

sentences.zh: 而留，二十八日。

translations.literal: Then it stations for twenty-eight days.
translations.idiomatic: Then it stations for 28 days.

sentences.zh: 乃退，日九十七分。

translations.literal: Then it retrogrades, 97 parts per day.
translations.idiomatic: Then it retrogrades at 97 parts per day.

sentences.zh: 八十四日退十二度五十分。

translations.literal: In 84 days it retrogrades 12 degrees 50 parts.
translations.idiomatic: In 84 days it retrogrades 12°50′.

sentences.zh: 又留，二十六日五百九十六，小分七四分。

translations.literal: It stations again for 26 days 596 [parts], minor parts 74.
translations.idiomatic: It stations again for 26 days 596 parts, with 74 minor parts.

sentences.zh: 即以初定見日分而加之，若滿行分法，即去之，從月去之，從一日。

translations.literal: Add the parts of the initial true-appearance day; if they fill the motion-part divisor, remove it and carry to the month, removing and carrying one day.
translations.idiomatic: Add the parts from the initial true-appearance day; when they fill the motion-part divisor, discard it and carry to the month, then carry 1 day.

sentences.zh: 乃順，初日行六十分，日益疾一分。

translations.literal: Then direct motion: on the first day 60 parts, daily acceleration of one part.
translations.idiomatic: Then direct motion at 60 parts on the first day, accelerating by 1 part daily.

sentences.zh: 一百十四日行十九度四百三十七分而伏。

translations.literal: In 114 days it travels 19 degrees 437 parts, then becomes occult.
translations.idiomatic: In 114 days it travels 19°437′, then goes into occultation.

sentences.zh: 初見：入冬至，初率二百四十一日行一百六十三度。

translations.literal: First appearance: entering winter solstice, initial rate 241 days for 163 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: First appearance: entering winter solstice, initial rate of 241 days for 163°.

sentences.zh: 已後二日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, decrease the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 2 days decrease the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡一百二十八日，率一百七十七日行九十九度。

translations.literal: When 128 days are exhausted, the rate is 177 days for 99 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 128 days, the rate becomes 177 days for 99°.

sentences.zh: 畢一百六十一日皆同。

translations.literal: For 161 days the rate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: For 161 days the rate remains unchanged.

sentences.zh: 已後三日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for three days, decrease the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 3 days decrease the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡一百八十二日，率一百七十日行九十二度。

translations.literal: When 182 days are exhausted, the rate is 170 days for 92 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 182 days, the rate becomes 170 days for 92°.

sentences.zh: 畢一百八十八日皆同。

translations.literal: For 188 days the rate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: For 188 days the rate remains unchanged.

sentences.zh: 已後三日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for three days, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 3 days increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡二百二十七日，率一百八十三日行一百五度。

translations.literal: When 227 days are exhausted, the rate is 183 days for 105 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 227 days, the rate becomes 183 days for 105°.

sentences.zh: 已後二日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 2 days increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡二百四十九日，率一百九十四日行一百一十六度。

translations.literal: When 249 days are exhausted, the rate is 194 days for 116 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 249 days, the rate becomes 194 days for 116°.

sentences.zh: 已後一日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for one day, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 1 day increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡三百一十日，率二百五十五日行一百七十七度。

translations.literal: When 310 days are exhausted, the rate is 255 days for 177 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 310 days, the rate becomes 255 days for 177°.

sentences.zh: 畢三百三十七日皆同。

translations.literal: For 337 days the rate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: For 337 days the rate remains unchanged.

sentences.zh: 已後二日損。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, decrease for 2 days.

sentences.zh: 盡三百六十五日，復二百四十一日行一百六十三度。

translations.literal: When 365 days are exhausted, it returns to 241 days for 163 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 365 days, the rate returns to 241 days for 163°.

sentences.zh: 初見：入小寒已後，三日去日率一，畢於啟蟄。

translations.literal: First appearance: after entering Minor Cold, for three days remove one from the daily solar rate; continue until Awakening of Insects.
translations.idiomatic: First appearance: after Minor Cold, subtract 1 from the daily solar rate for 3 days, through Awakening of Insects.

sentences.zh: 自入雨水，畢于立夏，均去日率二十。

translations.literal: From entering Rain Water through Beginning of Summer, uniformly remove twenty from the daily solar rate.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water through Beginning of Summer, uniformly subtract 20 from the daily solar rate.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿，初去日率二十。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness, initially remove twenty from the daily solar rate.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness, initially subtract 20 from the daily solar rate.

sentences.zh: 以次三日去十九，日日去十八。

translations.literal: For the next three days remove nineteen; each day remove eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: For the next 3 days subtract 19; each day thereafter subtract 18.

sentences.zh: 以次三日去一日，畢於小暑，即依平，為定日之率。

translations.literal: For the next three days remove one [each day]; continue until Minor Heat, then follow the mean—this is the fixed daily rate.
translations.idiomatic: For the next 3 days subtract 1 per day through Minor Heat, then follow the mean rate—this fixes the daily solar rate.

sentences.zh: 若入處暑，畢于秋分，皆去度率六，各依冬至後日數而損益之，又依所入之氣以減之，名為前疾。

translations.literal: If entering End of Heat through Autumn Equinox, remove six from the degree rate in all cases; each adjusts according to the day-count after winter solstice, and further subtract according to the qi entered—this is called initial swift motion.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Autumn Equinox, subtract 6 from the degree rate throughout, adjusting by the post-winter-solstice day-count and further by the qi entered—this phase is called initial swift motion.

sentences.zh: 日數及度數之率，若初行。

translations.literal: The rates for day-count and degree-count are as at the initial motion.
translations.idiomatic: The day-count and degree-count rates follow the initial motion.

sentences.zh: 入大寒，畢於大暑，皆差行，日益遲一分。

translations.literal: Entering Major Cold through Major Heat, all are differential motion, daily deceleration of one part.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Cold through Major Heat, all use differential motion, slowing by 1 part daily.

sentences.zh: 其餘皆平行。

translations.literal: All the rest are uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: All other periods use uniform motion.

sentences.zh: 若入白露，畢于秋分，初日行半度，四十日行二十度。

translations.literal: If entering White Dew through Autumn Equinox, on the first day travel half a degree; in 40 days travel 20 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew through Autumn Equinox, travel ½° on the first day and 20° in 40 days.

sentences.zh: 即去日率四十，度率二十，別為半度之行，訖，然後求平行之分以續之。

translations.literal: Then remove forty from the daily solar rate and twenty from the degree rate, set apart as half-degree motion; when finished, then find the uniform-motion parts to continue.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 40 from the daily solar rate and 20 from the degree rate, treat this as half-degree motion, then calculate uniform-motion parts to continue.

sentences.zh: 平行分者，置定行度率，以分法乘之，以定日率除之，所得即平行一日之分，不盡為小分。

translations.literal: For uniform-motion parts: set the fixed motion-degree rate, multiply by the part-divisor, divide by the fixed daily rate—the result is the one-day uniform-motion parts; the remainder is minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: For uniform motion: set the fixed degree-rate, multiply by the part-divisor, divide by the fixed daily rate—the quotient is the one-day uniform parts; the remainder is minor parts.

sentences.zh: 求差行者，置日率之數，減一。

translations.literal: To find differential motion: set the daily-rate number and subtract one.
translations.idiomatic: To find differential motion: take the daily rate and subtract 1.

sentences.zh: 訖，又半之，加平行一日之分，為初日行分。

translations.literal: When finished, halve it again, add the one-day uniform-motion parts—this is the first-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Halve the result, add the one-day uniform parts—this gives the first-day motion parts.

sentences.zh: 各盡其日度而遲。

translations.literal: Each exhausts its days and degrees, then slows.
translations.idiomatic: Each phase runs its allotted days and degrees, then enters slow motion.

sentences.zh: 初日行三百二十六分，日益遲一分半，六十日行二十五度五分。

translations.literal: First day 326 parts, daily deceleration of one and a half parts; in 60 days travel 25 degrees 5 parts.
translations.idiomatic: First day 326 parts, slowing by 1½ parts daily; in 60 days travel 25°5′.

sentences.zh: 其前疾去度六者，此遲初日加六十七分、小分三十六。

translations.literal: Where initial swift motion removed six degrees, on this slow-motion first day add 67 parts and 36 minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: When initial swift motion removed 6°, add 67 parts and 36 minor parts on the first day of slow motion.

sentences.zh: 小分滿六十，去之，從行分一，即六十日行三十一度，分同。

translations.literal: When minor parts fill sixty, remove and carry one to motion parts—in 60 days travel 31 degrees; the parts are the same.
translations.idiomatic: When minor parts reach 60, discard and carry 1 to motion parts—in 60 days travel 31° with matching parts.

sentences.zh: 而留，十二日。

translations.literal: Then it stations for twelve days.
translations.idiomatic: Then it stations for 12 days.

sentences.zh: 前去日分日於二留，奇後從後留。

translations.literal: The prior removal of daily parts is applied at the two stations; if there is a remainder, follow the later station.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the prior daily-part adjustment at both stations; any remainder follows the later station.

sentences.zh: 乃退，日一百九十二分，六十日退十七度二十八分。

translations.literal: Then it retrogrades, 192 parts per day; in 60 days it retrogrades 17 degrees 28 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then it retrogrades at 192 parts per day; in 60 days it retrogrades 17°28′.

sentences.zh: 又留，十二日六百二十六分、小分三十分。

translations.literal: It stations again for 12 days 626 parts, minor parts 30.
translations.idiomatic: It stations again for 12 days 626 parts, with 30 minor parts.

sentences.zh: 亦如初定見之分，滿去如前。

translations.literal: Also as with the parts of the initial true appearance—when full, remove as before.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the initial true-appearance parts as before; when full, discard and carry as above.

sentences.zh: 又順，後遲。

translations.literal: Again direct motion; afterward, slow motion.
translations.idiomatic: It moves direct again, then enters the subsequent slow-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 初日行二百三十八分，日益疾一分半，六十日行二十五度三十五分。

translations.literal: First day 238 parts, daily acceleration of one and a half parts; in 60 days travel 25 degrees 35 parts.
translations.idiomatic: First day 238 parts, accelerating by 1½ parts daily; in 60 days travel 25°35′.

sentences.zh: 此遲在立秋至秋分者，加一日，行六十七、小分三十六。

translations.literal: Where this slow motion falls between Beginning of Autumn and Autumn Equinox, add one day, travel 67 parts and 36 minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: When this slow-motion phase falls between Beginning of Autumn and Autumn Equinox, add 1 day and travel 67 parts with 36 minor parts.

sentences.zh: 滿去如前，即六十日行三十一度。

translations.literal: When full, remove as before—in 60 days travel 31 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: When full, discard and carry as before—in 60 days travel 31°.

sentences.zh: 分同也。

translations.literal: The parts are the same.
translations.idiomatic: The parts match.

sentences.zh: 而後疾。

translations.literal: Then comes later swift motion.
translations.idiomatic: Then comes the later swift-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 入冬至，初率二百一十四日行一百三十六度。

translations.literal: Entering winter solstice, initial rate 214 days for 136 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Entering winter solstice, initial rate of 214 days for 136°.

sentences.zh: 已後一日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for one day, decrease the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 1 day decrease the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡三十七日，率一百七十七日行九十九度。

translations.literal: When 37 days are exhausted, the rate is 177 days for 99 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 37 days, the rate becomes 177 days for 99°.

sentences.zh: 已後二日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, decrease the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 2 days decrease the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡五十七日，率一百六十七日行八十九度。

translations.literal: When 57 days are exhausted, the rate is 167 days for 89 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 57 days, the rate becomes 167 days for 89°.

sentences.zh: 畢七十九日皆同。

translations.literal: For 79 days the rate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: For 79 days the rate remains unchanged.

sentences.zh: 已後三日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for three days, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 3 days increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡一百三十日，率一百八十四日行一百六十度。

translations.literal: When 130 days are exhausted, the rate is 184 days for 160 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 130 days, the rate becomes 184 days for 160°.

sentences.zh: 已後二日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 2 days increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡一百四十四日，率一百九十一日行一百一十三度。

translations.literal: When 144 days are exhausted, the rate is 191 days for 113 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 144 days, the rate becomes 191 days for 113°.

sentences.zh: 已後一日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for one day, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 1 day increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡一百九十日，率二百三十七日行一百五十九度。

translations.literal: When 190 days are exhausted, the rate is 237 days for 159 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 190 days, the rate becomes 237 days for 159°.

sentences.zh: 已後一日益日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for one day, increase the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 1 day increase the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡二百一十日，率二百六十七日行一百八十九度。

translations.literal: When 210 days are exhausted, the rate is 267 days for 189 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 210 days, the rate becomes 267 days for 189°.

sentences.zh: 畢二百五十九日皆同。

translations.literal: For 259 days the rate is the same.
translations.idiomatic: For 259 days the rate remains unchanged.

sentences.zh: 已後二日損日及度各一。

translations.literal: Thereafter for two days, decrease the day-count and degrees by one each.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, for 2 days decrease the day-count and degrees by 1 each.

sentences.zh: 盡三百六十五日，復率二百一十四行一百三十六度。

translations.literal: When 365 days are exhausted, again the rate is 214 days for 136 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: After 365 days, the rate returns to 214 days for 136°.

sentences.zh: 後遲加六度者，此後疾去度率六，為定度。

translations.literal: Where later slow motion added six degrees, in this later swift motion remove six from the degree-rate—this is the fixed degree-total.
translations.idiomatic: If the later slow phase added 6°, subtract 6 from the degree-rate in this later swift phase—that fixes the degree-total.

sentences.zh: 各依冬至後日數而損益之，為後疾日及度之率。

translations.literal: Each follows the day-count after winter solstice to decrease and increase them—this yields the day- and degree-rates for later swift motion.
translations.idiomatic: Adjust each by the day-count after the Winter Solstice to obtain the day- and degree-rates for the later swift phase.

sentences.zh: 若入立夏，於夏至，日行半度，盡六十日，行三十度。

translations.literal: If entering Start of Summer through Summer Solstice, daily motion half a degree; when 60 days are exhausted, travel 30 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If the phase falls between Start of Summer and Summer Solstice, use ½° per day, covering 30° in 60 days.

sentences.zh: 若入小暑，於大暑，盡四十日，行二十度。

translations.literal: If entering Minor Heat through Major Heat, when 40 days are exhausted, travel 20 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If it falls between Minor Heat and Major Heat, it covers 20° in 40 days.

sentences.zh: 皆去日及度之率，別為半度之行，訖，然後求平行之分以續之。

translations.literal: All remove from the day- and degree-rates, separately treat as half-degree motion; when finished, then seek the uniform-motion parts to continue.
translations.idiomatic: Set aside the corresponding day- and degree-rates as a separate half-degree segment; when complete, calculate the uniform-motion parts and continue from there.

sentences.zh: 各盡其日度而伏。

translations.literal: Each exhausts its days and degrees, then becomes occult.
translations.idiomatic: Each phase runs through its allotted days and degrees, then goes into occultation.

sentences.zh: 初見：順，日行六十分，八十三日行七度二百四十八分。

translations.literal: First appearance: direct motion, 60 parts per day; in 83 days travel 7 degrees 248 parts.
translations.idiomatic: First appearance: direct motion at 60 parts per day, covering 7°248′ in 83 days.

sentences.zh: 而留，三十八日。

translations.literal: Then it stations for thirty-eight days.
translations.idiomatic: Then it stations for 38 days.

sentences.zh: 乃退，日四十一分，一百日退六度四十四分。

translations.literal: Then it retrogrades, 41 parts per day; in 100 days it retrogrades 6 degrees 44 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Then it retrogrades at 41 parts per day, covering 6°44′ in 100 days.

sentences.zh: 又留，三十七日六十一分小分四。

translations.literal: It stations again for 37 days 61 parts, minor parts 4.
translations.idiomatic: It stations again for 37 days 61 parts, 4 minor parts.

sentences.zh: 亦以初定見日分加之。

translations.literal: Also add the parts of the initial true-appearance day.
translations.idiomatic: Also add the parts from the initial true-appearance day.

sentences.zh: 滿去如前。

translations.literal: When full, remove as before.
translations.idiomatic: When full, discard and carry as before.

sentences.zh: 乃順，日行六十分，八十三日行七度二百四十八分而伏。

translations.literal: Then direct motion, 60 parts per day; in 83 days travel 7 degrees 248 parts, then becomes occult.
translations.idiomatic: Then direct motion at 60 parts per day, 7°248′ in 83 days, then goes into occultation.

sentences.zh: 晨初見：乃退，日一度半，十日退十五度。

translations.literal: Morning first appearance: then it retrogrades, 1½ degrees per day; in 10 days it retrogrades 15 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At morning first appearance it retrogrades at 1.5° per day, covering 15° in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 而留，九日。

translations.literal: Then it stations for nine days.
translations.idiomatic: Then it stations for 9 days.

sentences.zh: 乃順遲，差行。

translations.literal: Then direct slow motion, differential motion.
translations.idiomatic: Then it resumes direct slow motion with variable rate.

sentences.zh: 先遲，日益疾八分，四十日行三十度。

translations.literal: First slow, daily acceleration of eight parts; in 40 days travel 30 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning slow, it accelerates by 8 parts each day, covering 30° in 40 days.

sentences.zh: 若此遲入大雪已後，畢于小滿，即依此為定而求行分。

translations.literal: If this slow phase enters after Major Snow through Minor Fullness, follow this as fixed to seek motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: If this slow phase falls between Major Snow and Minor Fullness, use this as the fixed rate to calculate motion parts.

sentences.zh: 自入芒種，十日減一度為定度，畢於夏至。

translations.literal: From entering Grain in Ear, every ten days subtract one degree as fixed degrees, continuing until Summer Solstice.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain in Ear, subtract 1° every 10 days as the fixed total, through Summer Solstice.

sentences.zh: 自入小暑，畢於霜降，均減三度。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Heat through Frost Descent, evenly subtract three degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Heat through Frost Descent, subtract an even 3°.

sentences.zh: 自入立冬，初日減三度，後十日減一度，畢于霜降，小雪，皆為定度。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Winter, on the first day subtract three degrees; thereafter every ten days subtract one degree, continuing until Frost Descent and Minor Snow—all as fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Winter, subtract 3° on the first day and 1° every 10 days thereafter, through Frost Descent and Minor Snow—these are the fixed degrees.

sentences.zh: 求一日行分者，以行分法乘定度，以四十餘之，為平分，不盡為小分。

translations.literal: To seek one day's motion parts, multiply fixed degrees by the motion-parts divisor, divide by 40 for equal parts; what does not exhaust is minor parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find one day's motion parts, multiply the fixed degrees by the motion-parts factor and divide by 40 for equal parts; the remainder gives minor parts.

sentences.zh: 又以四乘三十九，以減平分，為初日行分。

translations.literal: Also multiply 4 by 39, subtract from equal parts—this is the first-day motion parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply 4 by 39, subtract from the equal parts—that yields the first day's motion parts.

sentences.zh: 平行，日一度，十五日行十五度。

translations.literal: Uniform motion: one degree per day; in 15 days travel 15 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Uniform motion: 1° per day, 15° in 15 days.

sentences.zh: 若此平行入小寒後，十日益日及度各一，畢於啟蟄。

translations.literal: If this uniform motion enters after Minor Cold, every ten days increase the day-count and degrees by one each, continuing until Awakening of Insects.
translations.idiomatic: If this uniform-motion phase begins after Minor Cold, increase both the day-count and degree-count by 1 every 10 days, through Awakening of Insects.

sentences.zh: 自入雨水之氣，皆二十一日行二十一度。

translations.literal: From entering the Rain Water qi, all travel 21 degrees in 21 days.
translations.idiomatic: From Rain Water onward, the rate is 21° in 21 days throughout.

sentences.zh: 自入春分後，十日減一，畢于立夏，即十五日。

translations.literal: From after Spring Equinox, every ten days subtract one, continuing until Start of Summer—that is, fifteen days.
translations.idiomatic: After Spring Equinox, decrease by 1 every 10 days through Start of Summer, ending at 15 days.

sentences.zh: 自入處暑，畢於寒露，即無此平行。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat through Cold Dew, then there is no this uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Cold Dew, this uniform-motion phase does not apply.

sentences.zh: 自入霜降，即四日益一，畢于大雪，後十五日行十五度。

translations.literal: From entering Frost Descent, every four days increase by one, continuing until Major Snow; thereafter 15 degrees in 15 days.
translations.idiomatic: From Frost Descent, increase by 1 every 4 days through Major Snow; then the rate is 15° in 15 days.

sentences.zh: 疾，百七十日行二百四度。

translations.literal: Swift motion: in 170 days travel 204 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Swift motion: 204° in 170 days.

sentences.zh: 前順遲減度者，計所減之數，以益此度為定度。

translations.literal: Where earlier direct slow motion diminished degrees, calculate what was subtracted and add it to this degree-total as fixed degrees.
translations.idiomatic: If the earlier direct slow phase subtracted degrees, add that amount to this phase's degree-total as the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 求一日行度及分者，以百七十日減度數，餘行以分法乘，以百七十餘之，所得為之日平行度分。

translations.literal: To seek one day's motion in degrees and parts, subtract the degree-number from 170 days, multiply the remaining travel by the parts divisor, divide by 170—the result is the daily uniform-motion degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find one day's motion in degrees and parts, subtract the degree-total from 170 days, multiply the remaining travel by the parts factor, and divide by 170—the quotient gives the daily uniform-motion degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 晨伏東方。

translations.literal: Morning occultation in the east.
translations.idiomatic: It goes into occultation in the morning in the east.

sentences.zh: 夕初見：順疾，百七十日行二百。

translations.literal: Evening first appearance: direct swift motion; in 170 days travel 200 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At evening first appearance, direct swift motion: 200° in 170 days.

sentences.zh: 畢于立夏，依此順疾。

translations.literal: Continuing until Start of Summer, follow this direct swift motion.
translations.idiomatic: Through Start of Summer, follow this direct swift rate.

sentences.zh: 入冬至已後，畢于立夏，依此率為定。

translations.literal: Entering after winter solstice through Start of Summer, follow this rate as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: From Winter Solstice through Start of Summer, use this as the fixed rate.

sentences.zh: 自入小滿，六日加一度。

translations.literal: From entering Minor Fullness, every six days add one degree.
translations.idiomatic: From Minor Fullness, add 1° every 6 days.

sentences.zh: 自入大暑初，畢於芒種，自入夏至，畢於小暑，均五度。

translations.literal: From entering the beginning of Major Heat through Grain in Ear, from entering Summer Solstice through Minor Heat, evenly five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: From the beginning of Major Heat through Grain in Ear, and from Summer Solstice through Minor Heat, adjust by an even 5°.

sentences.zh: 自入大暑，初加五度，後三日減一度，畢於氣盡。

translations.literal: From entering Major Heat, initially add five degrees; thereafter every three days subtract one degree, continuing until the qi is exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Heat, add 5° initially, then subtract 1° every 3 days until the qi period ends.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋，畢于大雪，還依本率。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Autumn through Major Snow, return to the original rate.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Autumn through Major Snow, revert to the base rate.

sentences.zh: 從白露畢春分，皆差行。

translations.literal: From White Dew through Spring Equinox, all differential motion.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew through Spring Equinox, all phases use variable motion.

sentences.zh: 先疾，日益遲一分半。

translations.literal: First swift, daily deceleration of one and a half parts.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning fast, it slows by 1.5 parts each day.

sentences.zh: 自入清明，畢於處暑，並平行，同晨疾。

translations.literal: From entering Clear Brightness through End of Heat, all uniform motion, same as morning swift motion.
translations.idiomatic: From Clear Brightness through End of Heat, use uniform motion matching the morning swift phase.

sentences.zh: 求差行者，半一百六十九，乃以一分半乘之，以加平行分，為初日行度分也。

translations.literal: To seek differential motion, halve 169, then multiply by one and a half parts, add to uniform-motion parts—this is the first-day motion in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: For variable motion, halve 169, multiply by 1.5 parts, add to the uniform-motion parts—that yields the first day's motion in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 平行，日一度，十五日行十五度。

translations.literal: Uniform motion: one degree per day; in 15 days travel 15 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Uniform motion: 1° per day, 15° in 15 days.

sentences.zh: 此平行入冬至後，十日減日及度各一，畢于立春。

translations.literal: If this uniform motion enters after winter solstice, every ten days decrease the day-count and degrees by one each, continuing until Start of Spring.
translations.idiomatic: If this uniform-motion phase begins after Winter Solstice, decrease both the day-count and degree-count by 1 every 10 days, through Start of Spring.

sentences.zh: 自入啟蟄，畢於芒種，皆均九日行九度。

translations.literal: From entering Awakening of Insects through Grain in Ear, all evenly travel 9 degrees in 9 days.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects through Grain in Ear, the rate is 9° in 9 days throughout.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至後，五日益一，畢於小暑。

translations.literal: From after Summer Solstice, every five days increase by one, continuing until Minor Heat.
translations.idiomatic: After Summer Solstice, increase by 1 every 5 days, through Minor Heat.

sentences.zh: 自入大暑，畢於氣盡，皆十五日行十五度。

translations.literal: From entering Major Heat until the qi is exhausted, all travel 15 degrees in 15 days.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Heat through the end of the qi period, the rate is 15° in 15 days throughout.

sentences.zh: 自入立秋後，六日一，畢于小雪。

translations.literal: From after Beginning of Autumn, every six days by one, continuing until Minor Snow.
translations.idiomatic: After Beginning of Autumn, adjust by 1 every 6 days, through Minor Snow.

sentences.zh: 自入大雪，畢於氣盡，皆十五日行十五度者也。

translations.literal: From entering Major Snow until the qi is exhausted, all travel 15 degrees in 15 days.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Snow through the end of the qi period, the rate is 15° in 15 days throughout.

sentences.zh: 順遲，差行。

translations.literal: Direct slow motion, differential motion.
translations.idiomatic: Direct slow motion with variable rate.

sentences.zh: 先疾，日益遲八分，四十日行三十度。

translations.literal: First swift, daily deceleration of eight parts; in 40 days travel 30 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning fast, it slows by 8 parts each day, covering 30° in 40 days.

sentences.zh: 前加度者，此依數減之，求一日行分，如晨遲准減者為加之。

translations.literal: Where degrees were added earlier, here subtract by that number; to seek one day's motion parts, as with morning slow use subtraction for addition.
translations.idiomatic: If degrees were added earlier, subtract that amount here; to find one day's motion parts, apply the morning slow procedure in reverse—where that called for subtraction, add instead.

sentences.zh: 又留，九日。

translations.literal: It stations again for nine days.
translations.idiomatic: It stations again for 9 days.

sentences.zh: 乃退，日半度，十日退五度，而夕伏西方。

translations.literal: Then it retrogrades, half a degree per day; in 10 days it retrogrades 5 degrees, then evening occultation in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Then it retrogrades at ½° per day, covering 5° in 10 days, and goes into occultation in the evening in the west.

sentences.zh: 辰星：晨初見，留，六日。

translations.literal: The Chronogram Star (Mercury): at morning first appearance, it stations for six days.
translations.idiomatic: Mercury: at morning first appearance it stations for 6 days.

sentences.zh: 順遲，日行一百六十九分，四日行一度。

translations.literal: Direct slow motion, 169 parts per day; in 4 days travel 1 degree.
translations.idiomatic: Direct slow motion at 169 parts per day, covering 1° in 4 days.

sentences.zh: 若初見入大寒，畢於啟蟄之內，即不須此遲行。

translations.literal: If first appearance enters Major Cold through within Awakening of Insects, then this slow motion is not needed.
translations.idiomatic: If first appearance falls between Major Cold and Awakening of Insects, omit this slow-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 平行，日一度，十日行十度。

translations.literal: Uniform motion: one degree per day; in 10 days travel 10 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Uniform motion: 1° per day, 10° in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 此平行若入大寒已後，二日去日及度各一，畢於二十日，日及度俱盡，即無此平行。

translations.literal: If this uniform motion enters after Major Cold, every two days remove one from the day-count and degrees each; when 20 days are exhausted, day and degree both exhausted—then there is no this uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: If this uniform-motion phase begins after Major Cold, decrease both the day-count and degree-count by 1 every 2 days; at 20 days both are used up—there is no uniform-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 疾，日行一度六百九十分，十日行十九度六分。

translations.literal: Swift motion: 1 degree 690 parts per day; in 10 days travel 19 degrees 6 parts.
translations.idiomatic: Swift motion at 1°690′ per day, covering 19°6′ in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 前無遲行者，此疾日減二百三分，十日行十七度四分。

translations.literal: If earlier there was no slow motion, this swift motion daily diminishes 203 parts; in 10 days travel 17 degrees 4 parts.
translations.idiomatic: If there was no slow phase earlier, reduce this swift motion by 203 parts per day, covering 17°4′ in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 晨伏東方。

translations.literal: Morning occultation in the east.
translations.idiomatic: It goes into occultation in the morning in the east.

sentences.zh: 夕初見：順疾，日行一度六百九分，十日行十九度六分。

translations.literal: Evening first appearance: direct swift motion, 1 degree 609 parts per day; in 10 days travel 19 degrees 6 parts.
translations.idiomatic: At evening first appearance, direct swift motion at 1°609′ per day, covering 19°6′ in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 此疾者，入小暑畢於處暑之內，日減二百三分，十日行十六度四分。

translations.literal: This swift phase, entering Minor Heat through within End of Heat, daily diminishes 203 parts; in 10 days travel 16 degrees 4 parts.
translations.idiomatic: If this swift phase falls between Minor Heat and End of Heat, reduce daily motion by 203 parts, covering 16°4′ in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 平行，日一度，十日行十度。

translations.literal: Uniform motion: one degree per day; in 10 days travel 10 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Uniform motion: 1° per day, 10° in 10 days.

sentences.zh: 此平行若入大暑已後，於二日去日及度各一。

translations.literal: If this uniform motion enters after Major Heat, every two days remove one from the day-count and degrees each.
translations.idiomatic: If this uniform-motion phase begins after Major Heat, decrease both the day-count and degree-count by 1 every 2 days.

sentences.zh: 畢於二十日，日及度俱盡，即無此平行。

translations.literal: When 20 days are exhausted, day and degree both exhausted—then there is no this uniform motion.
translations.idiomatic: At 20 days both day- and degree-rates are used up—there is no uniform-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 遲，日行一百六十九分，四日行一度。

translations.literal: Slow motion, 169 parts per day; in 4 days travel 1 degree.
translations.idiomatic: Slow motion at 169 parts per day, covering 1° in 4 days.

sentences.zh: 若疾減二百三分者，即不須此遲行。

translations.literal: If swift motion diminished 203 parts, then this slow motion is not needed.
translations.idiomatic: If the swift phase was reduced by 203 parts, omit this slow-motion phase.

sentences.zh: 又留，六日九分。

translations.literal: It stations again for six days nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: It stations again for 6 days 9 parts.

sentences.zh: 夕伏西方。

translations.literal: Evening occultation in the west.
translations.idiomatic: It goes into occultation in the evening in the west.

sentences.zh: 推交會

translations.literal: Computing Conjunctions and Crossings
translations.idiomatic: Method for Computing Conjunctions and Crossings

sentences.zh: 交會法：一千二百七十四萬一千二百五分。

translations.literal: Conjunction divisor: twelve million seven hundred forty-one thousand two hundred five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Conjunction divisor: 12,741,205 parts.

sentences.zh: 交分法：六百三十七萬六百二十九分。

translations.literal: Node-parts factor: six million three hundred seventy thousand six hundred twenty-nine parts.
translations.idiomatic: Node-parts factor: 6,370,629 parts.

sentences.zh: 朔差：一百八萬五千四百九十二分。

translations.literal: New-moon difference: one million eighty-five thousand four hundred ninety-two parts.
translations.idiomatic: New-moon difference: 1,085,492 parts.

sentences.zh: 望分：六百九十一萬三千三百五十分。

translations.literal: Full-moon parts: six million nine hundred thirteen thousand three hundred fifty parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon parts: 6,913,350 parts.

sentences.zh: 交限：五萬八十二萬七千八百五十八分。

translations.literal: Conjunction limit: five myriad eighty-two myriad seven thousand eight hundred fifty-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: Conjunction limit: 5,827,858 parts.

sentences.zh: 望差：五十四萬二千七百四十七一分。

translations.literal: Full-moon difference: five hundred forty-two thousand seven hundred forty-seven parts.
translations.idiomatic: Full-moon difference: 542,747 parts.

sentences.zh: 外限：六百七十六萬七百八十二九分。

translations.literal: Outer limit: six million seven hundred sixty thousand seven hundred eighty-two parts.
translations.idiomatic: Outer limit: 6,760,782 parts.

sentences.zh: 中限：一千二百三十五萬一千二十五八分。

translations.literal: Middle limit: twelve million three hundred fifty-one thousand twenty-five parts.
translations.idiomatic: Middle limit: 12,351,025 parts.

sentences.zh: 內限：一千二百一十九萬八千四百五十八七分。

translations.literal: Inner limit: twelve million one hundred ninety-eight thousand four hundred fifty-eight parts.
translations.idiomatic: Inner limit: 12,198,458 parts.

sentences.zh: 交時法：二萬九千一十八。

translations.literal: Node-time factor: twenty-nine thousand eighteen.
translations.idiomatic: Node-time factor: 29,018.

sentences.zh: 推交分術

translations.literal: Method for Computing Node Parts
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing Node Parts

sentences.zh: 置入上元已來積月，以交會法去之。

translations.literal: Set the accumulated months since the upper origin, remove by the conjunction divisor.
translations.idiomatic: Take the accumulated months since the upper origin and divide by the conjunction divisor.

sentences.zh: 餘，以朔差乘之。

translations.literal: The remainder, multiply by the new-moon difference.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the new-moon difference.

sentences.zh: 滿交會法，又去之。

translations.literal: When full of the conjunction divisor, again remove it.
translations.idiomatic: When the product fills the conjunction divisor, discard full multiples again.

sentences.zh: 仁均本術，武德年加交差七百七十五萬五千一百六十四分。

translations.literal: In Renjun's original method, in the Wude era add to the node difference seven million seven hundred fifty-five thousand one hundred sixty-four parts.
translations.idiomatic: In Renjun's original procedure, the Wude-era revision adds 7,755,164 parts to the node difference.

sentences.zh: 餘為所求年天正朔入平交分。

translations.literal: The remainder is the mean node parts at new moon of Heavenly First Month for the year sought.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the mean node parts for the new moon of the year's Heavenly First Month.

sentences.zh: 求望平交分術，以望分加之，滿去如前，為平分。

translations.literal: Method for seeking full-moon mean node parts: add full-moon parts to it; when full, remove as before—the result is mean parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean node parts at full moon, add the full-moon parts; discard full multiples as before, and the result is the mean parts.

sentences.zh: 次月平分術，其朔望，入冬至氣內，依平為定。

translations.literal: Mean-parts method for subsequent months: for new moon and full moon, if within the Winter Solstice qi, determine by the mean as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: For subsequent months, when new moon or full moon falls within the Winter Solstice solar term, follow the mean-rate procedure as fixed.

sentences.zh: 若入小寒已後，日加氣差一千六百五十分，畢于立春。

translations.literal: If after entering Minor Cold, daily add solar-term difference of 1,650 parts, continuing until Start of Spring.
translations.idiomatic: From entry into Minor Cold, add 1,650 parts of solar-term difference per day until Start of Spring.

sentences.zh: 自入啟蟄，畢于清明，均加七萬六千一百分。

translations.literal: From entering Awakening of Insects through Clear Brightness, uniformly add seventy-six thousand one hundred parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects through Clear Brightness, add 76,100 parts in total.

sentences.zh: 後日減一千六百五十分，畢于小滿。

translations.literal: On later days subtract 1,650 parts, continuing until Minor Fullness.
translations.idiomatic: On each subsequent day, subtract 1,650 parts until Minor Fullness.

sentences.zh: 置初日所加之分，計後日減之數以減之，餘以加平交分。

translations.literal: Set the parts added on the first day; subtract from it the total of later-day reductions; add the remainder to the mean node parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take the amount added on the first day, subtract the cumulative reductions for later days, and add the remainder to the mean node parts.

sentences.zh: 自入芒種，畢於夏至，依平為定。

translations.literal: From entering Grain in Ear through Summer Solstice, determine by the mean as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: From Grain in Ear through the Summer Solstice, follow the mean-rate procedure as fixed.

sentences.zh: 加之，滿交會法，即去。

translations.literal: Add it; when full of the conjunction divisor, remove at once.
translations.idiomatic: Add the result; when it fills the conjunction divisor, discard the multiple.

sentences.zh: 餘為定交分。

translations.literal: The remainder is the fixed node parts.
translations.idiomatic: What remains is the fixed node parts.

sentences.zh: 其朔入災交，若入小寒，畢于雨水，及立夏，畢于小滿，值盈二時已下，皆半氣差而加之。

translations.literal: If the new moon enters an eclipse-prone conjunction—if between Minor Cold and Rain Water, or between Beginning of Summer and Minor Fullness—when excess is below two hours, all add half the solar-term difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon falls in an eclipse-prone conjunction—between Minor Cold and Rain Water, or between Beginning of Summer and Minor Fullness—and the excess amounts to less than two hours, add half the solar-term difference in each case.

sentences.zh: 二時已上，皆不加。

translations.literal: Two hours and above, none add.
translations.idiomatic: If two hours or more, add nothing.

sentences.zh: 其朔入時交分，如望差分已下，外限已上，有星伏，木土去見十日外，火去見四十日外，金星伏去見二十二日外。
