translations.literal: If the new moon's timed node parts, like below the full-moon difference and above the outer limit, have concealed stars—Jupiter and Saturn more than ten days from appearance, Mars more than forty days from appearance, Venus in concealment more than twenty-two days from appearance.
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon's timed node parts fall below the full-moon difference and above the outer limit, and planets are invisible—Jupiter and Saturn more than ten days from appearance, Mars more than forty days from appearance, or Venus in morning or evening concealment more than twenty-two days from appearance—

sentences.zh: 有一星者，不加氣差。

translations.literal: If there is one star, do not add solar-term difference.
translations.idiomatic: if any one of these planets is present, do not add the solar-term difference.

sentences.zh: 其朔望，入小暑已後，日減氣差一千二百分，畢於處暑。

translations.literal: For new moon and full moon, after entering Minor Heat, daily subtract solar-term difference of one thousand two hundred parts, until ending at End of Heat.
translations.idiomatic: For new and full moons after Minor Heat, subtract 1,200 parts of solar-term difference per day until End of Heat.

sentences.zh: 自入白露，畢於霜降，均減九萬五千八百二十分。

translations.literal: From entering White Dew until Frost's Descent, uniformly subtract ninety-five thousand eight hundred twenty parts.
translations.idiomatic: From White Dew through Frost's Descent, subtract 95,820 parts in total.

sentences.zh: 自入立冬，初日減六萬三千三百分，後日減二千一百一十分，畢于小雪。

translations.literal: From entering Beginning of Winter, on the first day subtract sixty-three thousand three hundred parts, on later days subtract two thousand one hundred ten parts, until ending at Minor Snow.
translations.idiomatic: From Beginning of Winter, subtract 63,300 parts on the first day and 2,110 parts on each subsequent day until Minor Snow.

sentences.zh: 置初日所減之分，計後日減之數以減之，餘以減平交分也。

translations.literal: Set the parts subtracted on the first day; subtract from it the total of later-day subtractions; use the remainder to reduce the mean node parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take the amount subtracted on the first day, subtract the cumulative reductions for later days, and use the remainder to reduce the mean node parts.

sentences.zh: 自入大雪，亦依平為定。

translations.literal: From entering Major Snow, also determine by the mean as fixed.
translations.idiomatic: From Major Snow onward, follow the mean-rate procedure as fixed.

sentences.zh: 減若不足者，加交會法，乃減之。

translations.literal: If the subtraction is insufficient, add the conjunction divisor, then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is insufficient for subtraction, add one conjunction divisor before subtracting.

sentences.zh: 餘為定交分。

translations.literal: The remainder is the fixed node parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder gives the fixed node parts after adjustment.

sentences.zh: 其朔入交分，如交限內限已上，交分中限已下，有星伏如前者，不減氣差。

translations.literal: If the new moon's node parts, like above the inner limit of the conjunction limit and below the middle limit of node parts, have concealed stars as before, do not subtract solar-term difference.
translations.idiomatic: When the new moon's node parts lie above the inner conjunction limit and below the middle node limit, and planets are invisible as described above, do not subtract the solar-term difference.

sentences.zh: 推道在內外及先後去交術，其定交分不滿交分法者，為在外道。

translations.literal: Method for determining whether the path is inner or outer and whether departure from conjunction is before or after: if the fixed node parts do not fill the node-parts factor, it is on the outer path.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for determining inner versus outer path and distance before or after conjunction: if the fixed node parts amount to less than the node-parts factor, the moon is on the outer path.

sentences.zh: 滿去之，餘為在內道。

translations.literal: When full, remove it; the remainder is on the inner path.
translations.idiomatic: Discard one full node-parts factor; the remainder places the moon on the inner path.

sentences.zh: 其餘如望差已下，即是去先交分。

translations.literal: If the remainder is like below the full-moon difference, this is the parts of departure before conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is less than the full-moon difference, it is the distance before conjunction.

sentences.zh: 以時法約之得一，為去先交時數。

translations.literal: Reduce by the hour factor to obtain one—that is the number of hours of departure before conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by the hour factor; each unit is the number of hours before conjunction.

sentences.zh: 交限已上，即以減交分法。

translations.literal: Above the conjunction limit, then subtract the node-parts factor.
translations.idiomatic: If above the conjunction limit, subtract the node-parts factor instead.

sentences.zh: 餘為去後交分，亦以時法約之，為時數。

translations.literal: The remainder is the parts of departure after conjunction; also reduce by the hour factor to obtain the number of hours.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the distance after conjunction; divide again by the hour factor to obtain the number of hours.

sentences.zh: 望則月蝕也。

translations.literal: Full moon then is lunar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon there is a lunar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其朔在內道者，朔則日蝕。

translations.literal: If the new moon is on the inner path, new moon then is solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the new moon is on the inner path, there is a solar eclipse at new moon.

sentences.zh: 或雖在內道去交而遠，在外道去交而近，亦為蝕也。

translations.literal: Or even though on the inner path but far from conjunction, or on the outer path but near conjunction—these also count as eclipses.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the moon is on the inner path but far from conjunction, or on the outer path but near it, an eclipse may still occur.

sentences.zh: 推月蝕加時術

translations.literal: Method for Computing the Hour of Lunar Eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing the Hour of Lunar Eclipse

sentences.zh: 置有蝕之望定小餘。

translations.literal: Set the fixed minor remainder of the full moon at which there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Take the fixed minor remainder of the eclipsed full moon.

sentences.zh: 若入曆一日，即減二百八十。

translations.literal: If entering the sequence on day one, then subtract two hundred eighty.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is on the first day of the sequence, subtract 280.

sentences.zh: 入十五日，即加之。

translations.literal: Entering day fifteen, then add it.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day, add it back.

sentences.zh: 若入十四日，即加五百五十。

translations.literal: If entering day fourteen, then add five hundred fifty.
translations.idiomatic: If on the fourteenth day, add 550.

sentences.zh: 入二十八日，即減之。

translations.literal: Entering day twenty-eight, then subtract it.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day, subtract it.

sentences.zh: 自入諸日，值盈皆加二百八十，值縮皆減之，為定餘。

translations.literal: From entering the various days, when encountering excess add two hundred eighty throughout, when encountering contraction subtract throughout—the result is the fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For each day entered thereafter, add 280 when the moon is in excess and subtract when it is in contraction; the result is the fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 乃以十二乘之，以時法六千五百三除之，所得為半辰之數。

translations.literal: Then multiply by twelve and divide by the hour factor six thousand five hundred three; what is obtained is the number of half double-hours.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by twelve and divide by the hour factor, 6,503; the quotient is the number of half double-hours.

sentences.zh: 命以子半起算外，即所在辰。

translations.literal: Assign starting from midnight outside the count—that is the double-hour position.
translations.idiomatic: Count from midnight, and the double-hour reached outside the count is the position.

sentences.zh: 初命子半以一算，自後皆以二算為一辰。

translations.literal: Initially assign midnight with one count; thereafter each double-hour takes two counts.
translations.idiomatic: Midnight counts as one; each subsequent double-hour counts as two.

sentences.zh: 不盡為時餘。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is the hour remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the fractional part within the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 若時餘在辰半之前者，乃倍之。

translations.literal: If the hour remainder is before the middle of the double-hour, then double it.
translations.idiomatic: If the fractional remainder falls before the middle of the double-hour, double it.

sentences.zh: 如法無所得，為辰初。

translations.literal: If by the factor nothing is obtained, it is the start of the double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If division by the factor yields nothing, the time is the start of the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 又以三因之，如法得一，名為強。

translations.literal: Also multiply by three; by the factor obtain one—named strong.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by three; each unit obtained by division is called a strong.

sentences.zh: 若得強，若得二強，即名少弱。

translations.literal: If one strong is obtained, or if two strongs are obtained, then name it minor-weak.
translations.idiomatic: One strong, or two strongs, yields the designation minor-weak.

sentences.zh: 若倍之，如法得一，為少。

translations.literal: If doubled, by the factor obtain one—that is minor.
translations.idiomatic: If doubled, each unit obtained is minor.

sentences.zh: 凡四分一為少，二為半，三為太。

translations.literal: In general one of four is minor, two is half, three is major.
translations.idiomatic: In quarter divisions, one is minor, two is half, and three is major.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，又三之，如法得一，名為強。

translations.literal: What remains, multiply by three again; by the factor obtain one—named strong.
translations.idiomatic: For whatever remains, multiply by three again; each unit obtained is a strong.

sentences.zh: 若得二強者，即名為半弱。

translations.literal: If two strongs are obtained, then name it half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: Two strongs yield the designation half-weak.

sentences.zh: 若時餘在辰半之後者亦倍之。

translations.literal: If the hour remainder is after the middle of the double-hour, also double it.
translations.idiomatic: If the fractional remainder falls after the middle of the double-hour, double it as well.

sentences.zh: 如法無所得，為正在辰半。

translations.literal: If by the factor nothing is obtained, it is precisely at the middle of the double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If division yields nothing, the time is exactly the middle of the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 以三因之，如法得二，名為強，即名半強。

translations.literal: Multiply by three; by the factor obtain two—named strong, then name half-strong.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by three; two units obtained are one strong, yielding the designation half-strong.

sentences.zh: 若得二強，即名太弱。

translations.literal: If two strongs are obtained, then name major-weak.
translations.idiomatic: Two strongs yield the designation major-weak.

sentences.zh: 若倍之，如法得一，為態。

translations.literal: If doubled, by the factor obtain one—that is major.
translations.idiomatic: If doubled, each unit obtained is major.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，又三之，如法得一，為強，即名太強；

translations.literal: What remains, multiply by three again; by the factor obtain one as strong, then name major-strong;
translations.idiomatic: For whatever remains, multiply by three again; one unit obtained is a strong, yielding the designation major-strong;

sentences.zh: 若得者，又二強者，為辰末。

translations.literal: If obtained, and again two strongs, it is the end of the double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: If two strongs are obtained, the time is the end of the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 亦可前辰名之。

translations.literal: One may also name it from the preceding double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: It may also be named from the preceding double-hour.

sentences.zh: 月在沖上蝕，日出後入前各一時半外，不注蝕。

translations.literal: When the moon eclipses at opposition, if each of after sunrise and before sunset exceeds one and a half hours, do not record the eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon eclipses at opposition, if the eclipse falls more than one and a half hours after sunrise or before sunset, do not record it.

sentences.zh: 推日蝕加時術

translations.literal: Method for Computing the Hour of Solar Eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing the Hour of Solar Eclipse

sentences.zh: 置有蝕之朔定小餘。

translations.literal: Set the fixed minor remainder of the new moon at which there is an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Take the fixed minor remainder of the eclipsed new moon.

sentences.zh: 若入曆一日，即減三百。

translations.literal: If entering the sequence on day one, then subtract three hundred.
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is on the first day of the sequence, subtract 300.

sentences.zh: 入十五日，即加之。

translations.literal: Entering day fifteen, then add it.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifteenth day, add it back.

sentences.zh: 若入十四日，即加五百五十。

translations.literal: If entering day fourteen, then add five hundred fifty.
translations.idiomatic: If on the fourteenth day, add 550.

sentences.zh: 入二十八日，即減之以為定。

translations.literal: Entering day twenty-eight, then subtract it to make fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth day, subtract it to obtain the fixed value.

sentences.zh: 自後不入四時加減之限。

translations.literal: From here onward do not enter the limits of seasonal addition and subtraction.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the seasonal addition-and-subtraction limits no longer apply.

sentences.zh: 春三月，內道，去交四時已上，入曆，值盈加二百八十，值縮反減之。

translations.literal: In the three months of spring, on the inner path, departure from conjunction four hours and above, entering the sequence, when encountering excess add two hundred eighty, when encountering contraction subtract in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, on the inner path, when the moon is more than four hours from conjunction and has entered the sequence, add 280 if in excess and subtract if in contraction.

sentences.zh: 夏三月，內道，值盈加二百八十，值縮反減之。

translations.literal: In the three months of summer, on the inner path, when encountering excess add two hundred eighty, when encountering contraction subtract in reverse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the inner path, add 280 if in excess and subtract if in contraction.

sentences.zh: 秋三月，內道，去交十一時已下，值盈加二百八十，值縮不加；

translations.literal: In the three months of autumn, on the inner path, departure from conjunction eleven hours and below, when encountering excess add two hundred eighty, when encountering contraction do not add;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the inner path, when the moon is within eleven hours of conjunction, add 280 if in excess and do not add if in contraction;

sentences.zh: 十一時已上，值盈加五百五十，值縮不加一百八十。

translations.literal: Eleven hours and above, when encountering excess add five hundred fifty, when encountering contraction subtract one hundred eighty instead of adding.
translations.idiomatic: if more than eleven hours from conjunction, add 550 if in excess and subtract 180 if in contraction.

sentences.zh: 冬三月，內道，去交五時已下，值盈加二百八十，縮不加。

translations.literal: In the three months of winter, on the inner path, departure from conjunction five hours and below, when encountering excess add two hundred eighty, when in contraction do not add.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the inner path, when within five hours of conjunction, add 280 if in excess and do not add if in contraction.

sentences.zh: 皆為定餘。

translations.literal: All are the fixed remainder.
translations.idiomatic: These yield the fixed remainder.

sentences.zh: 乃以十二乘之，以時法除之，所得半辰之數，命以子半起算外，即所在辰。

translations.literal: Then multiply by twelve and divide by the hour factor; what is obtained is the number of half double-hours; assign starting from midnight outside the count—that is the double-hour position.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by twelve and divide by the hour factor to obtain the number of half double-hours; count from midnight, and the double-hour reached outside the count is the position.

sentences.zh: 命辰如前法。

translations.literal: Assign the double-hour by the method above.
translations.idiomatic: Determine the double-hour by the method above.

sentences.zh: 不盡為時餘，別置為副。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust is the hour remainder; set it aside separately as auxiliary.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the fractional part within the double-hour; set it aside as an auxiliary value.

sentences.zh: 若入仲辰半前，即以副減法，餘為差率。

translations.literal: If entering before the middle of a cardinal double-hour, then subtract the auxiliary from the factor; the remainder is the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the time falls before the middle of a cardinal double-hour, subtract the auxiliary from the factor; the remainder is the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 若在半後，即退其半辰，還以法加餘，即以副為差率。

translations.literal: If after the middle, then retreat one half double-hour, again add the remainder to the factor, and take the auxiliary as the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If after the middle, retreat one half double-hour, add the remainder back to the factor, and use the auxiliary as the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 若入季辰半前，即以法加副，而為差率。

translations.literal: If entering before the middle of a seasonal double-hour, then add the auxiliary to the factor to make the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If before the middle of a seasonal double-hour, add the auxiliary to the factor to obtain the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 若在半後，即其半辰，還以法加餘，乃倍法以加副，而為差率。

translations.literal: If after the middle, then take its half double-hour, again add the remainder to the factor, then double the factor and add the auxiliary to make the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If after the middle, take one half double-hour, add the remainder back to the factor, double the factor and add the auxiliary, and the result is the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 若入孟辰半前，即三因其法，而以副減之，餘為差率。

translations.literal: If entering before the middle of an angular double-hour, then triple the factor and subtract the auxiliary; the remainder is the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If before the middle of an angular double-hour, triple the factor and subtract the auxiliary; the remainder is the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 若半後，即退其半辰，還以法加餘，又以法加副，乃三因其法而以副減之，為差率。

translations.literal: If after the middle, then retreat one half double-hour, again add the remainder to the factor, also add the factor to the auxiliary, then triple the factor and subtract the auxiliary to make the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If after the middle, retreat one half double-hour, add the remainder to the factor and the factor to the auxiliary, then triple the factor and subtract the auxiliary to obtain the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 又置去交時數，三已下加三，六已下加二，九已下加一，九已上依數，十二以上從十二，以乘差率。

translations.literal: Also set the hours of departure from conjunction: three and below add three; six and below add two; nine and below add one; nine and above follow the number; twelve and above use twelve; multiply the difference rate by this.
translations.idiomatic: Also take the hours from conjunction: if three or fewer, add three; if six or fewer, add two; if nine or fewer, add one; if more than nine, use the number itself; if twelve or more, use twelve; multiply the difference rate by this value.

sentences.zh: 若在季辰半後，孟辰半前，去交六時以上者，皆從其六，以乘差率。

translations.literal: If after the middle of a seasonal double-hour and before the middle of an angular double-hour, departure from conjunction six hours and above—in all cases use six to multiply the difference rate.
translations.idiomatic: If the time falls after the middle of a seasonal double-hour and before the middle of an angular double-hour, and the moon is six or more hours from conjunction, use six to multiply the difference rate.

sentences.zh: 六時已下，自依數，不須加。

translations.literal: Six hours and below, follow the number itself; no addition is needed.
translations.idiomatic: If six hours or fewer, use the number itself without addition.

sentences.zh: 如十四得一，為時差。

translations.literal: Divide by fourteen to obtain one—that is the time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Divide by fourteen; the quotient is the time difference.

sentences.zh: 子至卯半，午至酉半，以時餘加之；

translations.literal: From zi to the middle of mao, and from wu to the middle of you, add the hour remainder;
translations.idiomatic: From zi through the middle of mao, and from wu through the middle of you, add the hour remainder;

sentences.zh: 卯至午半，酉至子半，以減時餘。

translations.literal: From mao to the middle of wu, and from you to the middle of zi, subtract the hour remainder.
translations.idiomatic: from mao through the middle of wu, and from you through the middle of zi, subtract the hour remainder.

sentences.zh: 加之若滿時法者，乃去之，加於辰，即進之於前也。

translations.literal: If in adding it fills the hour factor, then remove it and add to the double-hour—that is advancing to the one before.
translations.idiomatic: If addition fills the hour factor, discard the multiple and carry one to the double-hour, advancing to the preceding one.

sentences.zh: 減之若不足者，減半辰，加時法，乃減之，即退之於後也。

translations.literal: If in subtracting it is insufficient, subtract one half double-hour, add the hour factor, then subtract—that is retreating to the one after.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction is insufficient, retreat one half double-hour, add the hour factor, then subtract, moving back to the following one.

sentences.zh: 餘為定時餘。

translations.literal: The remainder is the fixed hour remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the fixed fractional part within the double-hour.

sentences.zh: 乃如月蝕法，子午卯酉為仲，辰戌醜未為季，寅申已亥為孟。

translations.literal: Then as with the lunar-eclipse method: zi, wu, mao, and you are cardinal; chen, xu, chou, and wei are seasonal; yin, shen, si, and hai are angular.
translations.idiomatic: Then, as with the lunar-eclipse method, name the fractional part: zi, wu, mao, and you are cardinal double-hours; chen, xu, chou, and wei are seasonal; yin, shen, si, and hai are angular.

sentences.zh: 日出前後各一時半外，不注日蝕。

translations.literal: If each of before and after sunrise exceeds one and a half hours, do not record the solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse falls more than one and a half hours before or after sunrise, do not record it.

sentences.zh: 推內道日不蝕術

translations.literal: Method for When the Inner Path Does Not Eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for When the Inner Path Does Not Eclipse

sentences.zh: 夏五月朔，加時在南方三辰，先交十三時外，六月朔，後交十三時外者，不蝕。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the fifth month of summer, if the computed hour is in the three southern double-hours and before conjunction exceeds thirteen hours; on the new moon of the sixth month, if after conjunction exceeds thirteen hours—no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth-month new moon of summer, if the computed hour falls in the three southern double-hours and the moon is more than thirteen hours before conjunction; or on the sixth-month new moon, if it is more than thirteen hours after conjunction—no eclipse occurs.

sentences.zh: 啟蟄畢清明，先交十三時外，值縮，加時在未巳西者，亦不蝕。

translations.literal: From Awakening of Insects through Clear Brightness, before conjunction exceeding thirteen hours, when encountering contraction, if the computed hour is in wei, si, or the western double-hours—also no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects through Clear Brightness, if the moon is more than thirteen hours before conjunction, is in contraction, and the computed hour falls in wei, si, or the western double-hours, there is also no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 入處暑，畢寒露，後交十三時，值盈，加時在己巳東者，亦不蝕。

translations.literal: From entering End of Heat through Cold Dew, after conjunction thirteen hours, when encountering excess, if the computed hour is in si, ji, or the eastern double-hours—also no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: From End of Heat through Cold Dew, if the moon is thirteen hours after conjunction, is in excess, and the computed hour falls in si, ji, or the eastern double-hours, there is also no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推外道日蝕術

translations.literal: Method for Solar Eclipse on the Outer Path
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Solar Eclipse on the Outer Path

sentences.zh: 不問交之先後，但去交一時內者，皆蝕也。

translations.literal: Without asking whether conjunction is before or after, if merely within one hour of conjunction—all eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Regardless of whether conjunction comes before or after, if the moon is within one hour of conjunction, there is always an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 若先交二時內者，值盈二時外者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: If before conjunction within two hours, when encountering excess beyond two hours—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If before conjunction within two hours and the moon is in excess more than two hours from conjunction, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 若後交二時內，值縮二時外者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: If after conjunction within two hours, when encountering contraction beyond two hours—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If after conjunction within two hours and the moon is in contraction more than two hours from conjunction, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 其夏去交二時在南方三辰者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: In summer, if departure from conjunction is two hours and the computed hour is in the three southern double-hours—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, if the moon is two hours from conjunction and the computed hour falls in the three southern double-hours, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 若去分至十二時內，去交六時內者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: If within twelve hours of an equinox or solstice and within six hours of conjunction—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If the eclipse falls within twelve hours of an equinox or solstice and within six hours of conjunction, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 若去交春分三日內，後交二時內者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: If within three days of the Spring Equinox node and within two hours after conjunction—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If within three days of the Spring Equinox and within two hours after conjunction, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋分三日內，先交二時內者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: Within three days of the Autumn Equinox, if within two hours before conjunction—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Within three days of the Autumn Equinox, if the moon is within two hours before conjunction, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 諸去交三時內，星伏如前者，亦蝕。

translations.literal: For all within three hours of conjunction, when stars are concealed as before—also eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the moon is within three hours of conjunction and planets are invisible as described above, there is also an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 推月蝕分術

translations.literal: Method for Computing Lunar Eclipse Magnitude
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing Lunar Eclipse Magnitude

sentences.zh: 置去交分。

translations.literal: Set the parts of departure from conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Take the parts of departure from conjunction.

sentences.zh: 其在冬，先後交皆去不蝕分二時之數。

translations.literal: In winter, whether before or after conjunction, in all cases subtract the number of two hours' worth of non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, subtract two hours' worth of non-eclipse parts whether conjunction comes before or after.

sentences.zh: 若在於春，先交去半時，後交去二時。

translations.literal: If in spring, before conjunction subtract half an hour; after conjunction subtract two hours.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, subtract half an hour before conjunction and two hours after conjunction.

sentences.zh: 夏即依定。

translations.literal: In summer, follow the fixed value as is.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, use the fixed value unchanged.

sentences.zh: 若在於秋，先交去二時，後交去半時。

translations.literal: If in autumn, before conjunction subtract two hours; after conjunction subtract half an hour.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, subtract two hours before conjunction and half an hour after conjunction.

sentences.zh: 若不足去者，蝕既，乃以三萬六千一百八十三為法除之，所得為不蝕分。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, the eclipse is total; then use thirty-six thousand one hundred eighty-three as divisor; the quotient is the non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is total; otherwise divide by 36,183, and the quotient is the non-eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，半法已上為半強，已下為半弱，而以減十五，餘為蝕之大分。

translations.literal: Of the remainder, above half the divisor counts as half-strong, below as half-weak; subtract from fifteen; the remainder is the great parts of the eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder, count above half the divisor as half-strong and below as half-weak; subtract from fifteen, and the remainder is the eclipse magnitude in great parts.

sentences.zh: 推月蝕所起術

translations.literal: Method for Determining Where the Lunar Eclipse Begins
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Determining Where the Lunar Eclipse Begins

sentences.zh: 若在外道，初起東北，蝕甚西北。

translations.literal: If on the outer path, it first begins in the northeast; greatest obscuration is in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the outer path, obscuration first appears in the northeast and reaches its maximum in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 若在內道，初起東南，蝕甚西南。

translations.literal: If on the inner path, it first begins in the southeast; greatest obscuration is in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the inner path, obscuration first appears in the southeast and reaches its maximum in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 十三分已上，正東起。

translations.literal: Thirteen parts and above, it begins due east.
translations.idiomatic: If the magnitude is thirteen parts or more, obscuration begins due east.

sentences.zh: 推皆據正南而言。

translations.literal: All reckonings are stated with reference to due south.
translations.idiomatic: All these directions are reckoned from due south.

sentences.zh: 推日蝕分術

translations.literal: Method for Computing Solar Eclipse Magnitude
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing Solar Eclipse Magnitude

sentences.zh: 置去交分。

translations.literal: Set the parts of departure from conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: Take the parts of departure from conjunction.

sentences.zh: 若入冬至已後，畢于立春，皆均減十二萬八百，餘為不蝕分。

translations.literal: If from after Winter Solstice through Start of Spring, uniformly subtract one hundred twenty thousand eight hundred; the remainder is non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: From after the Winter Solstice through the Start of Spring, subtract 120,800 in total; the remainder is the non-eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，反以交分減之，餘為不蝕分。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, subtract in reverse from the node parts; the remainder is non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: If the remainder is insufficient, subtract from the node parts instead; what remains is the non-eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 亦減望差為定法。

translations.literal: Also subtract the full-moon difference to make the fixed factor.
translations.idiomatic: Also subtract the full-moon difference to obtain the fixed factor.

sentences.zh: 其後交值縮者，直以望差為定法，不須減之。

translations.literal: When after conjunction encounters contraction, use the full-moon difference directly as the fixed factor; no subtraction is needed.
translations.idiomatic: When conjunction comes after and the moon is in contraction, take the full-moon difference itself as the fixed factor without subtracting it.

sentences.zh: 自入啟蟄，初日減二十二萬八百分，後日減一千八百一十分，置初日所減之分，計後日減之數以減之，餘以減交分。

translations.literal: From entering Awakening of Insects, on the first day subtract two hundred twenty-eight thousand parts, on later days subtract one thousand eight hundred ten parts; set the parts subtracted on the first day, subtract the cumulative later-day reductions, and use the remainder to reduce the node parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Awakening of Insects, subtract 228,000 parts on the first day and 1,810 parts on each later day; take the first day's subtraction, subtract the running total of later reductions, and use the remainder to reduce the node parts.

sentences.zh: 畢於芒種。

translations.literal: Until ending at Grain in Ear.
translations.idiomatic: Continue until Grain in Ear.

sentences.zh: 自入夏至，日減二千四百分，畢于白露。

translations.literal: From entering Summer Solstice, daily subtract two thousand four hundred parts, until ending at White Dew.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice, subtract 2,400 parts per day until White Dew.

sentences.zh: 自入秋分，畢于大雪，皆均減二十二萬八百分。

translations.literal: From entering Autumn Equinox through Great Snow, uniformly subtract two hundred twenty-eight thousand parts.
translations.idiomatic: From the Autumn Equinox through Great Snow, subtract 228,000 parts in total.

sentences.zh: 但不足減者，皆如前，反以交分減之，訖，皆為不蝕。

translations.literal: Whenever insufficient to subtract, all as before: subtract in reverse from the node parts; when finished, all become non-eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever subtraction is insufficient, reverse the operation against the node parts as before; when this is done, the result is the non-eclipse portion throughout.

sentences.zh: 若入冬至，畢於小寒，不蝕分依定。

translations.literal: If from entering Winter Solstice through Slight Cold, non-eclipse parts follow the fixed value.
translations.idiomatic: From the Winter Solstice through Slight Cold, the non-eclipse parts follow the fixed value unchanged.

sentences.zh: 若入大寒，畢于立夏，後去交五時外，皆去不蝕分一時。

translations.literal: If from entering Great Cold through Beginning of Summer, when after conjunction exceeds five hours, in all cases subtract one hour's worth of non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: From Great Cold through Beginning of Summer, if the moon is more than five hours after conjunction, subtract one hour's worth of non-eclipse parts in every case.

sentences.zh: 時差值減者，先交減之，後交加之。

translations.literal: When the time difference calls for subtraction, subtract from before conjunction and add to after conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: When the time difference requires subtraction, subtract from the before-conjunction figure and add to the after-conjunction figure.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，蝕既。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, the eclipse is total.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 時差值加者，先交加之，後交減之。

translations.literal: When the time difference calls for addition, add to before conjunction and subtract from after conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: When the time difference requires addition, add to the before-conjunction figure and subtract from the after-conjunction figure.

sentences.zh: 不足減者，蝕既。

translations.literal: If insufficient to subtract, the eclipse is total.
translations.idiomatic: If subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is total.

sentences.zh: 乃為定分，以十五乘之，以定法除之，所得為不蝕分。

translations.literal: This becomes the fixed parts; multiply by fifteen and divide by the fixed factor; the quotient is non-eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take this as the fixed parts, multiply by fifteen, and divide by the fixed factor; the quotient is the non-eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 不盡者，半法已上為半強，已下為半弱，而以減十五，餘為蝕之大分也。

translations.literal: Of the remainder, above half the divisor counts as half-strong, below as half-weak; subtract from fifteen; the remainder is the great parts of the eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: For the remainder, count above half the divisor as half-strong and below as half-weak; subtract from fifteen, and the remainder is the eclipse magnitude in great parts.

sentences.zh: 推日蝕所起術

translations.literal: Method for Determining Where the Solar Eclipse Begins
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Determining Where the Solar Eclipse Begins

sentences.zh: 若在外道，初起西南，蝕甚東南。

translations.literal: If on the outer path, it first begins in the southwest; greatest obscuration is in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the outer path, obscuration first appears in the southwest and reaches its maximum in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 若在內道，初起西北，蝕甚東北。

translations.literal: If on the inner path, it first begins in the northwest; greatest obscuration is in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the inner path, obscuration first appears in the northwest and reaches its maximum in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 十三度已上，正西起。

translations.literal: Thirteen degrees and above, it begins due west.
translations.idiomatic: If the obscuration is thirteen degrees or more, it begins due west.

sentences.zh: 亦據正南而言之。

translations.literal: Also stated with reference to due south.
translations.idiomatic: These directions, too, are reckoned from due south.

sentences.zh: 求日出入所在術

translations.literal: Method for Finding Sunrise and Sunset Times
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Finding Sunrise and Sunset Times

sentences.zh: 以所入氣辰刻及分，與後氣辰刻及分相減。

translations.literal: Subtract the double-hour quarters and parts of the entered qi from those of the following qi.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the entered solar term's sunrise or sunset double-hour quarters and parts from those of the next solar term.

sentences.zh: 餘乘入氣日算，以十五除之。

translations.literal: Multiply the remainder by the day count within the qi and divide by fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the remainder by the number of days elapsed within the solar term and divide by fifteen.

sentences.zh: 所得以加減所入氣為定日出人。

translations.literal: Add or subtract the result to or from the entered qi to obtain fixed sunrise and sunset.
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract this result to the entered solar term's value to obtain the fixed times of sunrise and sunset.

sentences.zh: 從冬至至夏至，日出減之，日入加之。

translations.literal: From Winter Solstice to Summer Solstice, subtract for sunrise and add for sunset.
translations.idiomatic: From the Winter Solstice to the Summer Solstice, subtract for sunrise and add for sunset.

sentences.zh: 從夏至至冬至，日出加之，日入減之。

translations.literal: From Summer Solstice to Winter Solstice, add for sunrise and subtract for sunset.
translations.idiomatic: From the Summer Solstice to the Winter Solstice, add for sunrise and subtract for sunset.

sentences.zh: 入餘為定刻及分。

translations.literal: The entry remainder is the fixed quarters and parts.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder within the double-hour is the fixed quarter and fractional parts.

sentences.zh: 武德九年五月二日校曆人前曆博士臣南宮子明

translations.literal: Wude year 9, second day of the fifth month: calendar verifier, former Calendar Doctor, subject Nangong Ziming.
translations.idiomatic: On the second day of the fifth month in Wude year 9: calendar verifier, former Calendar Doctor Nangong Ziming.

sentences.zh: 校曆人前曆博士臣薛弘疑

translations.literal: Calendar verifier, former Calendar Doctor, subject Xue Hongyi.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar verifier, former Calendar Doctor Xue Hongyi.

sentences.zh: 校曆人算曆博士臣王孝通

translations.literal: Calendar verifier, Computational Calendar Doctor, subject Wang Xiaotong.
translations.idiomatic: Calendar verifier, Computational Calendar Doctor Wang Xiaotong.

sentences.zh: 監校曆大理卿清河縣公崔善為

translations.literal: Superintendent of calendar verification, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, Duke of Qinghe County, Cui Shanwei.
translations.idiomatic: Superintendent of calendar verification, Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review and Duke of Qinghe County, Cui Shanwei.

sentences.zh: 夜漏半

translations.literal: Half the night clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Half the night clepsydra duration.

sentences.zh: 右依武德元年經，加於漏刻日出沒二十四氣下。

translations.literal: Per the Wude yuan nian classic at right, add below the clepsydra quarters of sunrise and sunset under the twenty-four qi.
translations.idiomatic: As prescribed in the Wude yuan nian classic, enter these values below the clepsydra quarters for sunrise and sunset under each of the twenty-four solar terms.

sentences.zh: 推月蝕加時術

translations.literal: Method for Computing the Hour of Lunar Eclipse
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Computing the Hour of Lunar Eclipse

sentences.zh: 右加有蝕之望，以百刻乘定小餘，日法而一，以課所近氣不滿夜半者，命日以甲子算上注曆。

translations.literal: For full moons with eclipse at right: multiply the fixed minor remainder by a hundred quarters, divide by the day factor; test against the nearest qi for shortfall before midnight; assign the day and enter on the calendar from the jiazi count.
translations.idiomatic: For each eclipsed full moon, multiply the fixed minor remainder by a hundred quarters and divide by the day factor; check whether the nearest solar term falls short of midnight, assign the day, and enter it on the calendar from the jiazi count.

sentences.zh: 推月蝕虧初復滿先造每箭更籌用刻

translations.literal: Method for Lunar Eclipse First Contact and Full Recovery: Pre-establishing the Quarter-Use for Each Clepsydra Arrow and Watch Tally
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Lunar Eclipse First Contact and Full Recovery: Pre-establishing the Quarter-Use for Each Clepsydra Arrow and Watch Tally

sentences.zh: 倍月蝕日所入氣夜漏半，二十五而一，為籌刻分，亦注於曆下。

translations.literal: Double the half-night clepsydra of the qi entered on the lunar-eclipse day, divide by twenty-five; this is the tally quarter-parts, also entered below on the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Double the half-night clepsydra for the solar term on the day of the lunar eclipse and divide by twenty-five; the result is the tally quarter-parts, entered below on the calendar.

sentences.zh: 月蝕分用刻率置月蝕分

translations.literal: Lunar Eclipse Magnitude Quarter-Rate: set the lunar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Table of lunar eclipse magnitude quarter-rates: take the lunar eclipse parts.

sentences.zh: 推日月蝕加時定刻術

translations.literal: Method for Fixed Quarters of Solar and Lunar Eclipse Hour-Addition
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for Fixed Quarters of Solar and Lunar Eclipse Hour-Addition

sentences.zh: 置日月蝕加時定餘。

translations.literal: Set the fixed remainder of solar or lunar eclipse hour-addition.
translations.idiomatic: Take the fixed remainder of the solar or lunar eclipse hour-addition.

sentences.zh: 在辰半後者，加時法于時餘，以二十五乘之，三萬九千一十八而一刻，命刻算外，即所入辰刻。

translations.literal: If after the middle of the double-hour, add the hour-addition factor to the hour remainder, multiply by twenty-five, obtain one quarter per thirty-nine thousand eighteen; count quarters from the tally—the result is the entered double-hour quarter.
translations.idiomatic: If the time falls after the middle of the double-hour, add the hour-addition factor to the hour remainder, multiply by twenty-five, and take one quarter for every 39,018; count off the quarters, and the result is the entered double-hour quarter.

sentences.zh: 求虧初復滿術

translations.literal: Method for First Contact and Full Recovery
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for First Contact and Full Recovery

sentences.zh: 置蝕分，用刻率副之，以乘所入曆損益率，四千五十七而一。

translations.literal: Set the eclipse parts with the quarter-rate as auxiliary; multiply by the calendar increase-decrease rate entered; divide by four thousand fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: Set the eclipse parts with the quarter-rate as auxiliary, multiply by the entered calendar increase-decrease rate, and divide by 4,057.

sentences.zh: 值盈反其損益，值縮依其損諡，副為蝕定用刻數，乃六乘之，十而一，以減蝕加時辰刻，為虧初。

translations.literal: When encountering excess, reverse the increase and decrease; when encountering contraction, follow the increase and decrease; the auxiliary becomes the fixed eclipse quarter-count; multiply by six, divide by ten, subtract from the eclipse hour-addition double-hour quarter—this is first contact.
translations.idiomatic: If in excess, reverse the increase and decrease; if in contraction, apply the increase and decrease as given; take the auxiliary as the fixed eclipse quarter-count, multiply by six, divide by ten, and subtract from the eclipse hour-addition double-hour quarter to obtain first contact.

sentences.zh: 丈四乘餘之用刻數，十而一，以加蝕加時辰刻，為復滿。

translations.literal: Again multiply the remainder's quarter-count by four; divide by ten and add to the eclipse hour-addition double-hour quarter—this is full recovery.
translations.idiomatic: Again multiply the remainder's fixed quarter-count by four, divide by ten, and add to the eclipse hour-addition double-hour quarter to obtain full recovery.

sentences.zh: 求所蝕夜初甚末更籌刻術

translations.literal: Method for First, Maximum, and Last Watch Tallies of the Eclipse Night
translations.idiomatic: Procedure for First, Maximum, and Last Watch Tallies of the Eclipse Night

sentences.zh: 因其日日所入辰殘刻及分，依次加辰刻及分，至蝕初辰刻及分，減二刻十二分，從其更用刻及分除之，不滿更，即初蝕更籌。

translations.literal: From the entered double-hour's remaining quarters and parts of that day, add double-hour quarters and parts in sequence until the first-contact double-hour quarter and parts; subtract two quarters and twelve parts; divide by the watch's quarter-use and parts; if less than one watch, this is the first-eclipse watch tally.
translations.idiomatic: From that day's entered double-hour with its remaining quarters and parts, add double-hour quarters and parts in sequence until first contact; subtract two quarters and twelve parts; divide by the watch's quarter-use and parts, and if the result is less than one full watch, that is the first-eclipse watch tally.

sentences.zh: 依所求得至甚刻加之，命即甚。

translations.literal: Add the quarters to maximum as obtained by the method; assign, and that is maximum.
translations.idiomatic: Add the quarters to maximum as obtained by the method and assign the time; that is maximum obscuration.

sentences.zh: 依求得甚後刻數加之，命即末更籌刻及分。

translations.literal: Add the post-maximum quarters as obtained; assign, and that is the last watch tally's quarters and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the post-maximum quarters as obtained and assign the time; that is the last watch tally's quarters and parts.

sentences.zh: 日出前復滿，日入後初虧，皆不注蝕。

translations.literal: If full recovery comes before sunrise, or first contact after sunset—in all cases do not record the eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: If full recovery occurs before sunrise or first contact after sunset, do not record the eclipse.
